erikbernhardsson.en: AI infrastructure must be rebuilt from scratch for GPU workloads, not wrapped over Kubernetes and Docker; developer and agent experience share the same foundations.
erikbernhardsson.zh: AI 基础设施必须为 GPU 负载从零重建，而不是套在 Kubernetes 和 Docker 之上；开发者体验与智能体体验共享同一套基础。

erikbernhardsson.en: Compute is scarce but obtainable at higher prices and longer terms; aggregating demand across 25+ clouds beats three-year rectangular deals.
erikbernhardsson.zh: 算力稀缺但可获取，代价是更高价格与更长合约；聚合 25+ 云的需求，胜过三年期“矩形”合约。

erikbernhardsson.en: Durable differentiation comes from a multi-product platform and proprietary infra alpha—own file system, container runtime, scheduler—not cheap token serving.
erikbernhardsson.zh: 持久差异化来自多产品平台与自研基础设施 alpha——自有文件系统、容器运行时、调度器——而非廉价 token 服务。

erikbernhardsson.en: Open source is leaned into heavily, contributing to vLLM and SGLang while keeping infra alpha proprietary; fine-tuning is no longer mandatory.
erikbernhardsson.zh: 重度投入开源，向 vLLM 和 SGLang 贡献，同时保留基础设施 alpha 专有；微调不再是必选项。

erikbernhardsson.en: Reversing prior view: GPU rental prices will rise over the next 12 months; compute is not fungible and the market stays inefficient.
erikbernhardsson.zh: 推翻此前观点：未来 12 个月 GPU 租赁价格将上涨；算力并非可互换资产，市场将长期低效。

sundarpichai.en: AI investment is redefining every Alphabet business, with frontier model development prioritized in compute allocation above core products.
sundarpichai.zh: 2026 年，AI 投资正重新定义 Alphabet 各项业务；在算力分配上，前沿模型研发被置于核心产品之上。

sundarpichai.en: Safety needs defense in depth: alignment, real-time monitoring, sandboxing, and independent evaluators; standard models are insufficient at the frontier.
sundarpichai.zh: 2026 年，安全需要纵深防御：对齐、实时监控、沙箱与独立评估方；在前沿层面，标准模型并不够用。

sundarpichai.en: World models are key to intelligence; Google pursues both LLMs and world models on the path to AGI.
sundarpichai.zh: 2026 年，世界模型是智能的关键；Google 在通往 AGI（通用人工智能）的路上同时押注大语言模型与世界模型。

sundarpichai.en: Agentic experiences expand Search use cases and monetization rather than cannibalizing ads; trust and safety drive consumer agent adoption.
sundarpichai.zh: 2026 年，智能体式体验扩展搜索场景与变现，而非蚕食广告；信任与安全推动消费级智能体普及。

sundarpichai.en: Compute demand far exceeds supply; overbuilding may occur, but long-term demand justifies the buildout and high-ROIC prioritization.
sundarpichai.zh: 2026 年，算力需求远超供给；可能出现过度建设，但长期需求支撑扩建，并优先高回报项目。

marvinschwaibold.en: AI tools amplify rather than replace creativity, letting designers prototype and iterate independently; curiosity and hands-on experimentation keep designers relevant.
marvinschwaibold.zh: 2026 年，他认为 AI 工具放大而非取代创造力，让设计师能独立做原型、快速迭代；好奇心与亲手实验是设计师保持相关性的关键。

marvinschwaibold.en: Designers shift from executors to editors: AI handles execution while human judgment curates quality, since AI raises the ceiling but doesn't know what looks good.
marvinschwaibold.zh: 2026 年，他把设计师的角色从执行者转为编辑者：AI 负责执行，人类判断把关品质，因为 AI 抬高了上限却不知道什么好看。

marvinschwaibold.en: Prototypes built with AI persuade faster than PRD documents; break complex tasks into subtasks and feed them iteratively to AI agents.
marvinschwaibold.zh: 2026 年，他强调用 AI 做出的原型比 PRD 文档更有说服力；把复杂任务拆成子任务，迭代地喂给智能体。

marvinschwaibold.en: Designers should build and test in code, commit pull requests, and expose parameters like DialKit to fine-tune AI-generated designs.
marvinschwaibold.zh: 2026 年，他主张设计师应写代码、提 pull request，并用 DialKit 之类工具暴露底层参数来微调 AI 生成的设计。

marvinschwaibold.en: Less is more: progressive disclosure, clear hierarchy and native scroll beat tabs and scroll-jacking; curation and human craft matter more than AI-generated animation.
marvinschwaibold.zh: 2026 年，他坚持少即是多：渐进披露、清晰层级与原生滚动优于标签页和滚动劫持；策展与人工手艺比 AI 生成的动画更重要。

ariweinstein.en: Computer use has crossed from demo to superhuman speed, and the bottleneck is now website load time, not model intelligence.
ariweinstein.zh: 到 2026 年，computer use 已从演示跨越到超人速度，瓶颈不再是模型智能，而是网站加载时间。

ariweinstein.en: Agents should use all human-designed software via accessibility trees and DOM, not screenshot-scroll loops, completing the dev lifecycle by testing their own code.
ariweinstein.zh: 智能体应通过无障碍树和 DOM 使用所有人类设计的软件，而非截图滚动循环，并通过测试自己的代码完成开发全生命周期。

ariweinstein.en: The scaling moment for computer use has arrived in consumer and enterprise at once; proactivity and deterministic controls, sandboxing, human-in-the-loop dials build trust.
ariweinstein.zh: computer use 的 Scaling（规模扩张）时刻已在消费端与企业端同时到来；主动性、确定性控制、沙箱与人类在环调节共同建立信任。

ariweinstein.en: Legacy software and UI won't vanish; computer use coexists with and pressures them, while startups keep a moat in deep industry expertise and complex workflows.
ariweinstein.zh: 传统软件与 UI 不会消失；computer use 与之共存并施压，而初创公司在深厚行业专长与复杂工作流上仍有护城河。

ariweinstein.en: People now let agents configure DNS and pay bills with real money, a 180-degree reversal from claims computer use hasn't advanced in two years.
ariweinstein.zh: 人们如今让智能体配置 DNS、用真钱付账单，这与两年前“computer use 毫无进展”的说法完全相反。

ethanmollick.en: AI is a general-purpose technology; juniors misuse it without expertise, and human taste and voice become key differentiators.
ethanmollick.zh: 2026 年，他认为 AI 是通用技术，缺乏专业经验的初级员工会误用它；人类品味与独特声音成为关键差异化优势。

ethanmollick.en: We enter the agentic era: AI runs long tasks independently; the bottleneck shifts from capability to interface, and delegation erodes expertise.
ethanmollick.zh: 2026 年，他提出进入智能体时代：AI 独立执行长任务；瓶颈从能力转向界面，而委托任务会侵蚀专业判断力。

ethanmollick.en: AI's exponential curve and jagged frontier mean humans remain essential; more AI creates more work by lowering organizing costs.
ethanmollick.zh: 2026 年，他强调 AI 的指数曲线与锯齿状前沿意味着人类仍不可或缺；更多 AI 通过降低组织成本创造更多工作。

ethanmollick.en: Organizations must rebuild workflows from the ground up for augmentation, not just automation; incremental productivity targets miss the point.
ethanmollick.zh: 2026 年，他主张组织必须从底层重建工作流以实现增强而非仅自动化；渐进式生产力目标不得要领。

ethanmollick.en: Use AI as a tutor that challenges you, not an answer machine; prompting tricks like chain-of-thought no longer help—just ask directly.
ethanmollick.zh: 2026 年，他建议把 AI 当作挑战你的导师而非答案机器；思维链等提示技巧不再有效，直接提问即可。

dario.en: Scaling laws are empirical; abilities emerge unpredictably, but loss scales smoothly. Alignment is not guaranteed by Scaling alone.
dario.zh: 2023 年他强调 Scaling（规模扩张）是经验规律，具体能力不可预测地涌现，但统计损失可预测；对齐不会仅靠 Scaling 自动实现。

dario.en: Interpretability is crucial but nascent; post-training and RLHF become as important as pre-training. AGI is a smooth exponential, not a single point.
dario.zh: 2024 年他深化可解释性主张，认为其关键但尚处早期；后训练与基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）变得与预训练同等重要；AGI 是平滑指数曲线而非单点。

dario.en: Safety and capabilities are intertwined; exponential progress continues. AGI term is meaningless; focus on actual capabilities and enterprise adoption.
dario.zh: 2025 年他主张安全与能力交织、指数进步持续；认为 AGI 一词无意义，应关注实际能力与企业采用，并强调智能体式产品需适配快速变化的模型。

dario.en: We are near the end of the exponential; a 'country of geniuses' may arrive in 1-3 years. High GDP growth with high unemployment is unprecedented.
dario.zh: 2026 年他警告公众未意识到已接近指数终点，'数据中心里的天才之国'可能 1-3 年到来；高 GDP 增长与高失业并存是前所未有的宏观组合。

dario.en: Scaling laws remain the throughline; mechanistic interpretability and layered safeguards are the consistent safety approach, with decentralized control over a single constitution.
dario.zh: 贯穿始终的主线是缩放定律持续有效；机制可解释性与分层防护是一贯的安全路径，并主张去中心化控制而非单一宪法。

andreessen.en: AI is a philosopher's stone turning sand into thought; its timing is miraculous as population declines, so human workers stay at a premium.
andreessen.zh: AI 是点沙成思的魔法石；它恰逢人口下降而降生，时机堪称奇迹，因此人类劳动者反而更稀缺、更值钱。

andreessen.en: AGI is not a singular event; human-level is just a footnote on the way to superhuman, and the real bottleneck is regulation, not capability.
andreessen.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）不是单一事件，人类水平只是通往超人能力路上的一个脚注；真正的瓶颈是监管而非能力。

andreessen.en: Models lack durable moats and are commoditizing; open source is crucial to prevent power concentration and to help solve reward hacking.
andreessen.zh: 模型没有持久护城河，正被快速商品化；开源对防止权力集中、帮助解决奖励黑客问题至关重要。

andreessen.en: AI embeds cultural values and becomes a geopolitical tool; Western values in models matter for allies' trust and to avoid censorship.
andreessen.zh: AI 内嵌文化价值、成为地缘政治工具；模型中的西方价值观关系到盟友信任与免于审查。

andreessen.en: The biggest gap is now between AI early adopters and everyone else; individuals adopt faster than institutions, so startup formation will skyrocket.
andreessen.zh: 如今最大的鸿沟在 AI 早期采用者与其他人之间；个人比机构采用得更快，因此创业公司将激增。

robsnyder.en: Demand is a project on someone's to-do list, not a pain point; test it by whether they try to buy now.
robsnyder.zh: 需求是某人待办清单上正在推进的项目，而非痛点；用对方是否立刻尝试购买来检验。

robsnyder.en: The pull framework requires project, unavoidable now, list of options, and limitations to all exist simultaneously.
robsnyder.zh: 拉力框架要求项目、当下不可避免、选项列表和限制条件四者同时存在。

robsnyder.en: Avoid design partners and proactive pilots; sell directly to one hell-yes customer, then build a case study factory.
robsnyder.zh: 避免设计伙伴和主动试点；直接卖给一个“绝对要”的客户，然后打造案例研究工厂。

robsnyder.en: Sales is research: it tests actual purchase, unlike error-prone customer interviews; go to the gemba to observe.
robsnyder.zh: 销售即研究：它检验实际购买，而非易出错的客户访谈；去现场观察。

robsnyder.en: Tech comes last: sell as a service first, automate only after demand is proven; make the product seem small.
robsnyder.zh: 技术最后：先作为服务出售，需求验证后再自动化；让产品显得小。

joonpark.en: LLMs encode human behavior from training data, enabling realistic agent simulations that predict behavior about 85% as accurately as people replicate themselves.
joonpark.zh: 2026 年，他认为 LLM 能从训练数据中编码人类行为，从而支撑逼真的智能体模拟，预测准确率约为人类自我复现水平的 85%。

joonpark.en: The frontier is modeling subjective values and diversity, not super-rational intelligence; frontier models optimized for rationality are poor at simulating irrational humans.
joonpark.zh: 2026 年，他主张前沿方向是建模主观价值与多样性，而非超级理性的智能；为理性优化的前沿模型反而难以模拟非理性的人类。

joonpark.en: Behavioral and RCT data plus post-training close the say-do gap; simulation should shape the future via counterfactual reasoning, not merely predict it.
joonpark.zh: 2026 年，他强调行为数据与随机对照试验数据加后训练能弥合“说与做”的差距；模拟应通过反事实推理塑造未来，而不只是预测。

joonpark.en: AGI may be a distributed society of specialized agents, not one superintelligent entity; safety needs defense in depth and anti-collusion incentives.
joonpark.zh: 2026 年，他提出 AGI 可能不是单一超级智能，而是专业化智能体的分布式社会；安全需要纵深防御与反串谋激励。

joonpark.en: The vision scales to simulating 8 billion lives for wicked problems, with synthetic panels surpassing human panels and simulation costs rivaling foundation-model training.
joonpark.zh: 2026 年，他的愿景扩展到模拟 80 亿人应对棘手问题，合成样本将超越人类样本，模拟成本可与训练基础模型相当。

altman.en: Early framing: cut cognitive load, explore cheaply, then commit hard to what matters; AGI will lower the premium on raw intelligence.
altman.zh: 早期框架：减少认知负荷，低成本广泛探索后狠心聚焦真正重要的事；他预判 AGI（通用人工智能）会降低人类智力的溢价。

altman.en: RLHF makes models usable with little data; early public deployment lets society adapt, and alignment and capability reinforce each other.
altman.zh: 2023 到 2024 年，他强调基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）用极少数据就让模型可用，主张尽早公开部署让社会适应，并认为对齐与能力相互促进。

altman.en: Scaling keeps delivering; compute becomes the scarcest commodity, so massive infrastructure and iterative deployment are the path to safe AGI.
altman.zh: 2024 到 2025 年，Scaling（规模扩张）持续兑现，算力成为最稀缺的商品，因此大规模基础设施加迭代部署是通往安全 AGI 的路径。

altman.en: AGI becomes a gradient and superintelligence the real target; agentic AI is the top safety challenge, with humans kept in control.
altman.zh: 2025 到 2026 年，AGI 被重新定义为渐变过程，超级智能成为真正目标；智能体式 AI 成为首要安全挑战，人类必须保持控制权。

altman.en: Safety turns urgent: pause training if the safety case fails, distribute power widely, and treat loss of control as the core risk.
altman.zh: 到 2026 年，安全变得紧迫：安全论证不成立就暂停训练，广泛分散权力，并把失控视为核心风险。

andrewng.en: Education is a human right; online courses with auto- and peer grading can deliver mastery learning at scale.
andrewng.zh: 教育是基本人权；带自动评分与同伴评分的在线课程，能把掌握式学习规模化。

andrewng.en: Scale drives deep learning; start with small projects, and supervised learning beats RL hype.
andrewng.zh: 规模是深度学习的关键；从小项目起步，监督学习胜过被高估的强化学习。

andrewng.en: Scaling hits electricity and chip bottlenecks; open-weight models and agentic workflows are already delivering real value.
andrewng.zh: Scaling 撞上电力与芯片瓶颈；开放权重模型与智能体式工作流已在创造真实价值。

andrewng.en: AGI is a marketing term decades away; scaling still works but the recipe shifts to synthetic data and RL.
andrewng.zh: AGI 是营销术语，仍要数十年；Scaling 依然有效，但配方转向合成数据与强化学习。

andrewng.en: Fearmongering serves incumbents; AI automates tasks not jobs, and coding skills grow more valuable.
andrewng.zh: 恐惧叙事服务于既得利益者；AI 替代的是任务而非工作，编程技能反而更值钱。

jensen.en: Hyper Moore's Law: performance doubles or triples yearly at scale, driven by extreme co-design across algorithm, system, and data center.
jensen.zh: 2024 年提出“超摩尔定律”：在规模之上性能每年翻倍甚至三倍，靠算法、系统与数据中心的全栈协同设计驱动。

jensen.en: Three scaling laws emerge: pre-training, post-training, and inference-time thinking; chain-of-thought makes inference compute demand explode.
jensen.zh: 2025 年把 Scaling（规模扩张）拆成三条缩放定律：预训练、后训练与推理时思考；思维链让推理算力需求暴涨。

jensen.en: AI shifts from generative to reasoning to agentic; agents do payable work, and the internet fills with billions of agents.
jensen.zh: 2025 到 2026 年，AI 从生成式走向推理式再走向智能体式；智能体做可付费的实事，未来互联网由数十亿智能体驱动。

jensen.en: Safety reframed: alignment is part of capability; containment, monitoring, and zero-trust, not slowdown, secure autonomous systems.
jensen.zh: 2026 年重新定义安全：对齐属于能力的一部分；靠遏制、监控与零信任保障自主系统，而非放慢发展。

jensen.en: Doomer warnings dismissed as unscientific; AGI already reached in narrow domains; export controls and decoupling called counterproductive.
jensen.zh: 2026 年更近一步：称末日警告不科学，AGI 在窄领域已实现；出口管制与脱钩适得其反，主张加速与开放。

satya.en: AI is not a technology but the future of the firm; every enterprise must build its own hill-climbing machine and compound token capital.
satya.zh: AI 不是一项技术，而是企业的未来；每家企业都必须建立自己的爬坡机器，积累 token 资本。

satya.en: Scaling laws work, but alignment is not a natural outcome; treat frontier models as insider threats and build containment outside the model.
satya.zh: 缩放定律有效，但对齐不会自然到来；应把前沿模型当作内部威胁，在模型之外构建遏制层。

satya.en: Microsoft should be a frontier ecosystem, not just a frontier model; models are commodities, while form factor, distribution and pricing matter more.
satya.zh: 微软应做前沿生态，而非只做前沿模型；模型是商品，产品形态、分发与定价更重要。

satya.en: The real eval is people doing unique things they value; private evals may be the biggest IP, more valuable than models or data.
satya.zh: 真正的评估是人们做自己看重的独特之事；私有评估可能是最大的知识产权，比模型或数据更有价值。

satya.en: AGI should be measured by GDP lift; superintelligence is a better term than AGI, and being six months behind the frontier is smart.
satya.zh: AGI 应以 GDP 提升来衡量；超级智能比 AGI 更准确，落后前沿六个月是明智策略。

laurentan.en: Verification is the core skill for agents; encode constraints into CI, lints, and architecture to build trust and scale productivity.
laurentan.zh: 验证是智能体的核心技能；将约束编码进 CI、lints 和架构，以建立信任并扩展生产力。

laurentan.en: Engineers shift from writing code to managing agents: building environments, skills, and evals, and fixing the environment when failures occur.
laurentan.zh: 工程师从写代码转向管理智能体：构建环境、技能和评估，并在失败时修复环境。

laurentan.en: Agents can auto-merge PRs safely with strong verification, enabling review after landing and democratizing code contribution.
laurentan.zh: 智能体在强验证下可安全自动合并 PR，实现落地后审查，并民主化代码贡献。

harrisonchase.en: An agent is harness plus model plus context; owning all three is how you own your intelligence.
harrisonchase.zh: 智能体由 harness、模型与上下文三者构成；三者皆自持，才算真正拥有自己的智能。

harrisonchase.en: Agent failures come more from poor context than weak models, so observability into the context window is critical.
harrisonchase.zh: 智能体失败更多源于上下文不佳而非模型不足，因此对上下文窗口的可观测性至关重要。

harrisonchase.en: Harnesses are stabilizing around primitives like file systems and code execution, but must diverge for specialized domains.
harrisonchase.zh: harness 正围绕文件系统、代码执行等原语趋于稳定，但在专业领域必须分化。

harrisonchase.en: Customization is shifting from context engineering to post-training and reinforcement learning; this fine-tuning wave is genuinely different.
harrisonchase.zh: 定制化正从上下文工程转向后训练与强化学习；这一波微调与两年前被否定的那波确实不同。

harrisonchase.en: Inference demand is massively underestimated; routing belongs in the harness, and agent identity and governance are the next infrastructure problems.
harrisonchase.zh: 推理需求被严重低估；路由应放在 harness 而非网关，智能体身份与治理是下一个基础设施难题。

elon.en: Full and rapid reusability is rocketry's holy grail, cutting cost per ton to orbit 100x; first principles thinking drives breakthrough engineering.
elon.zh: 2021 年，他强调全复用与快速复用是火箭的圣杯，能把每吨入轨成本降低 100 倍；第一性原理思维是突破性工程的根基。

elon.en: AI safety needs truth-seeking AI and third-party referees; Tesla's real-world AI is more compute-efficient than large language models.
elon.zh: 2023 到 2024 年，他把 AI 安全落在追求真相的 AI 与第三方裁判上，并认为特斯拉的真实世界 AI 比大语言模型更省算力。

elon.en: Superintelligence may arrive within a year or two; he puts 10-20% annihilation risk against 80-90% great outcome.
elon.zh: 2024 到 2025 年，他判断超级智能可能一两年内到来，给出 10-20%毁灭风险对 80-90%美好结果的概率。

elon.en: Scaling hits Earth's power wall, so orbital data centers and space solar become the cheapest path within 36 months.
elon.zh: 2025 到 2026 年，Scaling（规模扩张）撞上地球电力墙，轨道数据中心与太空太阳能将在 36 个月内成为最便宜的路径。

elon.en: Humans won't control superintelligence; peer review among labs, not slow regulators, is the practical safety measure.
elon.zh: 到 2026 年，他认为人类无法控制超级智能，务实的安全手段是实验室之间每周互测，而非等待缓慢的监管。

arvindjain.en: Enterprises fear dependence on frontier model providers; Glean absorbs that model risk as a multi-model context layer.
arvindjain.zh: 2026 年，他认为企业害怕依赖前沿模型供应商；Glean 作为多模型上下文层替企业吸收这种模型风险。

arvindjain.en: Cost is the top enterprise concern; open source handles 90% of tasks and inference will shift to it.
arvindjain.zh: 2026 年，他强调成本是企业头号顾虑；开源模型已能处理 90%任务，推理将大规模转向开源。

arvindjain.en: Context, not models, is the key; 80-90% of enterprise knowledge is tacit and must be captured.
arvindjain.zh: 2026 年，他主张关键不在模型而在上下文；80-90%的企业知识是隐性的，必须被捕获。

arvindjain.en: AI ROI is a throughput problem measured by departmental metrics, not token spend versus headcount.
arvindjain.zh: 2026 年，他把 AI 的投资回报看作吞吐量问题，用部门指标衡量，而非拿 token 花费对比人力。

arvindjain.en: AI is still early; startups should focus on execution and trust, and enterprise memory should stay owned by the enterprise.
arvindjain.zh: 2026 年，他认为 AI 仍处早期；创业公司应专注执行与信任，企业记忆应归企业所有而非平台。

dylanfield.en: Design is the key differentiator in software; AI will merge roles so everyone becomes a product builder with design skills.
dylanfield.zh: 2025 年，他主张设计是软件的核心差异化因素；AI 会融合角色，让每个人都成为具备设计能力的产品构建者。

dylanfield.en: Taste, craft and point of view stay human; AI outputs are starting points, and direct manipulation on a canvas beats prompting.
dylanfield.zh: 2026 年初，他强调品味、手艺与观点仍属人类；AI 产出只是起点，画布上的直接操作优于提示词。

dylanfield.en: Design is not dead but more important for scalable systems; AI without human steering yields average results, and prompting will give way to new interfaces.
dylanfield.zh: 2026 年中，他重申设计未死，反而对可扩展系统更重要；缺乏人类引导的 AI 只产出平庸结果，提示词时代将让位于新交互界面。

dylanfield.en: Design is the new code: AI lowers the floor but humans raise the ceiling; model progress is mistaken for product progress.
dylanfield.zh: 2026 年末，他提出“设计即新代码”：AI 降低下限，人类抬高上限；人们常把模型进步误当成产品进步。

dylanfield.en: A consistent line: human judgment and taste remain the judge of what is good, even as AI democratizes production.
dylanfield.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：即便 AI 让生产民主化，人类判断与品味仍是“何为好”的裁判。

brockman.en: Early focus: hardware will accelerate faster than expected, enabling Scaling; most AI progress is engineering discipline, not novel ML science.
brockman.zh: 早期关注：硬件提速会超出预期，从而支撑 Scaling（规模扩张）；AI 进展主要靠工程纪律，而非全新的机器学习科学。

brockman.en: AGI is plausible via deep learning's generality and scalability, but Scaling alone won't yield reasoning—new ideas like chain of thought are needed.
brockman.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）因深度学习的通用性与可扩展性而可信，但仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）不会产生推理，需要思维链等新思路。

brockman.en: Compute becomes the core bottleneck; base models hold a universe of possibilities, post-training with reinforcement learning refines them into consistent behavior.
brockman.zh: 算力成为核心瓶颈；基础模型蕴含无限可能，后训练结合强化学习将其打磨为一致的行为。

brockman.en: Scaling laws still hold with no wall in sight; pre-training gains multiply downstream, and compute supply—not architecture or data—is the real constraint.
brockman.zh: 缩放定律依然成立、看不到墙；预训练收益会放大下游效果，真正的约束是算力供给，而非架构或数据。

brockman.en: AGI shifts from destination to fuzzy spectrum already underway; agents grow proactive, safety and alignment must scale as the bottleneck, humans stay accountable.
brockman.zh: AGI 从终点变为已在其中的模糊光谱；智能体走向主动，安全与对齐必须同步升级并成为瓶颈，人类仍负最终责任。

brendanfoody.en: RL environments are the new frontier for post-training, with humans essential for verifiers and rubrics; data differentiates AI strategy alongside compute and algorithms.
brendanfoody.zh: 2026 年，他认为强化学习环境是后训练的新前沿，人类在构建验证器和评分标准上不可或缺；数据与算力、算法并列成为 AI 战略的关键差异化因素。

brendanfoody.en: Model differentiation comes almost entirely from data, not algorithms; the bottleneck is building evals for everything, and RL can saturate an eval quickly.
brendanfoody.zh: 2026 年，他进一步指出模型差异化几乎完全来自数据而非算法；瓶颈在于为一切构建评估，而强化学习能快速饱和一个评估。

brendanfoody.en: Creating data to train AI will be the last human job; humans shift to training agents, and RL tasks with high-quality verifiers are far more valuable than raw data.
brendanfoody.zh: 2026 年，他提出为训练 AI 创造数据将是人类的最后一份工作；人类转向训练智能体，而带有高质量验证器的强化学习任务远比原始数据有价值。

brendanfoody.en: Models can't reliably grade their own homework; recursive self-improvement is limited in non-verifiable domains, and eval data must be human.
brendanfoody.zh: 2026 年，他强调模型无法可靠地给自己打分；在不可验证领域递归自我改进有限，评估数据必须由人类提供。

brendanfoody.en: The physical world will take decades for superintelligence due to low failure tolerance and slow iteration; frontier labs will in-house synthetic pipelines but rely on external human networks for evals.
brendanfoody.zh: 2026 年，他判断由于容错率低和迭代慢，超级智能进入物理世界需要数十年；前沿模型实验室将自建合成数据管道，但依赖外部人类网络做评估。

antonoglou.en: Scaling and planning, proven from AlphaGo to MuZero, are the core principles behind modern AI agents; reinforcement learning lets models improve beyond human data limits.
antonoglou.zh: 从 AlphaGo 到 MuZero 验证的 Scaling（规模扩张）与规划，是现代智能体的核心原则；强化学习让模型突破人类数据上限自我改进。

antonoglou.en: Synthetic data is essential to break the data wall, and LLMs still await their AlphaZero moment, perhaps in five years.
antonoglou.zh: 合成数据是突破数据墙的关键，而大模型尚未迎来自己的 AlphaZero 时刻，或许还要五年。

antonoglou.en: Digital AGI will arrive far earlier than embodied AGI, since controlled environments make robustness and reliability achievable first.
antonoglou.zh: 数字 AGI（通用人工智能）将远早于具身 AGI 到来，因为受控环境先让鲁棒性与可靠性成为可能。

antonoglou.en: The bottleneck has shifted from intelligence to deployment; open-weight models are safer because more researchers can probe and fix them.
antonoglou.zh: 瓶颈已从智能本身转向部署；开放权重模型更安全，因为更多研究者能探查并修复它。

antonoglou.en: Superintelligence isn't needed—customers want reliable regular intelligence; alignment matters because perfect sandboxes are impossible, and adoption will take 10-20 years.
antonoglou.zh: 不需要超级智能——客户要的是可靠的普通智能；完美沙箱不可能，所以对齐必要，而普及将耗时 10 到 20 年。

lambert.en: RLHF and fine-tuning are practical but fragile; safety is system-level, and open development prevents corporate capture.
lambert.zh: 2024 年，他强调基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）与微调虽实用却脆弱，安全是系统级属性，开放开发可防止企业垄断。

lambert.en: Data quality beats algorithms; post-training compresses industry recipes into open methods, with RLVR driving reasoning.
lambert.zh: 2024 至 2025 年，他从数据质量优于算法出发，把后训练视为将工业配方压缩为开放方法，并视 RLVR 为推理突破。

lambert.en: Open-source AI needs full transparency—data, checkpoints, recipes—as Chinese open models fill the US vacuum.
lambert.zh: 2025 年，他主张开源 AI 需数据、检查点与配方全透明，并指出中国开放模型填补了美国开源真空。

lambert.en: Scaling laws still hold for pre-training, but gains shift to post-training and inference scaling; open models lag 6-9 months.
lambert.zh: 2026 年初，他认为缩放定律在预训练仍成立，但收益转向后训练与推理扩展，开放模型落后闭源 6 至 9 个月。

lambert.en: Open models become the engine of AI research and sovereign AI, though compute gaps and sustainability concerns persist.
lambert.zh: 2026 年后期，他将开放模型视为 AI 研究与主权 AI 的引擎，同时承认算力差距与可持续性隐忧。

dsilver.en: AI must move from human data to learning from its own experience; human data is finite, experience is renewable.
dsilver.zh: 2025 年他提出，AI 必须从依赖人类数据转向从自身经验中学习；人类数据如化石燃料般有限，经验则可再生且无穷。

dsilver.en: LLMs are a shallow solution that cannot discover knowledge beyond human data; the era of human data is ending.
dsilver.zh: 同年他直言 LLM 只是浅层解法，无法发现人类数据之外的新知识，人类数据时代正在终结。

dsilver.en: AlphaZero and AlphaProof show learning from experience yields superhuman performance in narrow domains.
dsilver.zh: 他以 AlphaZero 与 AlphaProof 为例，说明从经验中学习能在特定领域达到超人表现。

dsilver.en: A single goal for AI is dangerous; a plurality of goals in a complex agent society is safer.
dsilver.zh: 他主张给 AI 设定单一目标是危险的，由多目标智能体构成的复杂社会更安全也更自然。

dsilver.en: Superintelligence will emerge from systems that autonomously learn and discover from experience, built first in simulation.
dsilver.zh: 到 2026 年他进一步深化：超级智能将诞生于能自主从经验中学习与发现的系统，并应先在模拟中构建。

dsilver.en: Language-based alignment is hitting its limits; monitoring chain of thought in English will become insufficient.
dsilver.zh: 他判断基于语言与人类数据的对齐正逼近极限，用英文监控思维链将越来越不够用。

awang.en: AGI is far off; data, not infinite compute, is the bottleneck, and boring applications will matter most.
awang.zh: 2019 年他认为 AGI（通用人工智能）还很遥远，瓶颈是数据而非无限算力，枯燥的应用（表单处理、放射科）反而经济影响最大。

awang.en: Data is the new code, not oil; the limiting factor for Scaling（规模扩张）is data and expert post-training, not compute.
awang.zh: 2023 年他把数据称为“新代码”而非“新石油”，指出 Scaling（规模扩张）的瓶颈是数据与专家后训练，而非算力，并强调专有数据微调与混合人机系统。

awang.en: Data remains the bottleneck; post-training and synthetic data need care, and agentic AI is blocked by product design, not models.
awang.zh: 2024 年延续数据瓶颈论，强调后训练与合成数据需谨慎，并判断智能体式 AI 的真正阻碍是产品设计而非模型能力。

awang.en: Data becomes strategic raw material; AI centralizes power, and recursive self-improvement plus working agents mark a new paradigm.
awang.zh: 2025 到 2026 年，数据升级为战略原材料，AI 是集中化而非民主化技术；递归自我改进与真正可用的智能体标志新范式，Scaling（规模扩张）定律继续成立。

awang.en: Superintelligence is near; Meta shifts from full open source to selective release, with safety, scalable oversight and personal agents.
awang.zh: 2026 年他宣称超级智能临近，Meta 从完全开源转向按安全审查选择性发布，强调对齐、可扩展监督与面向大众的个人智能体。

fedus.en: Intelligence is not a scalar; AI capabilities are spiky, excelling in narrow domains rather than generalizing broadly.
fedus.zh: 智能不是一个标量；AI 能力是尖峰式的，在狭窄领域表现出色，而非广泛泛化。

fedus.en: Connecting AI to the physical world through closed-loop experiments is essential to accelerate science and materials discovery.
fedus.zh: 通过闭环实验将 AI 与物理世界连接起来，对加速科学和材料发现至关重要。

fedus.en: Scaling laws alone won't solve science; high-quality, low-noise experimental data is more valuable than extra compute.
fedus.zh: 仅靠缩放定律无法解决科学问题；高质量、低噪声的实验数据比额外算力更有价值。

fedus.en: Scientific discovery lies outside training data, so even a perfect frontier model must run real experiments against reality.
fedus.zh: 科学发现位于训练数据之外，因此即使完美的前沿模型也必须对现实进行真实实验。

fedus.en: AI self-improvement is happening now in software engineering but does not automatically generalize to biology or other fields.
fedus.zh: AI 自我改进如今在软件工程中正在发生，但不会自动泛化到生物学或其他领域。

laskin.en: Superintelligence will be a plurality of specialized intelligences, not one monolithic model; coding is a superintelligence-complete problem.
laskin.zh: 2025 年，他提出超级智能将是多种专门智能的集合，而非单一巨型模型；编程是“超级智能完备”的问题，解决它即可获得超级智能所需的全部能力。

laskin.en: Reinforcement learning makes models jagged: strong on specific tasks but not generally better; RAG is primitive for complex comprehension.
laskin.zh: 同年他强调强化学习会让模型变得“参差不齐”——擅长特定任务而非全面提升；并认为 RAG 过于原始，复杂理解需要智能体式搜索与神经检索。

laskin.en: The bitter lesson is about scaling with compute and search, not generalization; benchmarks like SWE-bench misalign with real engineering.
laskin.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他一贯主张“苦涩教训”讲的是用算力与搜索做 Scaling（规模扩张），而非泛化；SWE-bench 等基准与真实工程脱节，高分不等于有用的智能体。

laskin.en: Open models are the default safe state; alignment is mundane bug-patching, and more eyes make bugs shallow.
laskin.zh: 到 2026 年，他把开放性视为技术的默认安全状态，认为对齐不过是平凡的修 bug，更多双眼睛能让 bug 变浅；并称中国开源模型有益于世界、形成良性竞争。

laskin.en: RL on strong pre-training is the path to efficient agents; open-model token demand will surpass closed, and AI will accelerate science.
laskin.zh: 2026 年他进一步深化：在强预训练之上做强化学习是通往高效智能体的路径，开源模型的 token 需求将超过闭源，AI 将从博士级解题到真实实验大幅加速科学进步。

cristianoamon.en: 5G as critical infrastructure connecting everything to the cloud; Snapdragon integrates 5G, AI, CPU, GPU into one efficient SoC.
cristianoamon.zh: 早期把 5G 定位为像电力一样的关键基础设施，把一切连到云端；Snapdragon 把 5G、AI、CPU、GPU 集成进一颗高能效 SoC。

cristianoamon.en: Chips are critical to the economy; supply resilience needs geographic diversification; AR glasses are the next platform in 5-10 years.
cristianoamon.zh: 2022 年强调芯片对经济至关重要，供应链韧性需要地域多元化；并预判 AR 眼镜将在 5-10 年内成为下一代计算平台。

cristianoamon.en: Transforming from wireless to intelligent computing everywhere; hybrid AI splits on-device and cloud for privacy, latency and data-center offload.
cristianoamon.zh: 2024 年从无线通信转向无处不在的智能计算；混合 AI 把端侧与云端分工，兼顾隐私、时延并给数据中心卸载。

cristianoamon.en: Agents become the new center of digital life, replacing apps; phones persist but shift to peripheral; glasses and wearables rise.
cristianoamon.zh: 2026 年提出智能体成为数字生活新中心、取代应用；手机不消失但退居外围，眼镜与可穿戴崛起。

cristianoamon.en: Inference, not training, will dominate data centers; post-GPU disaggregated, power-efficient architectures win; 6G becomes sensing network.
cristianoamon.zh: 到 2026 年深化为：推理而非训练主导数据中心，后 GPU 的解耦高能效架构胜出；6G 演变为感知网络。

kohli.en: AI should target root-node scientific problems at scale, not narrow applications; AlphaFold 3 extends from proteins to biomolecular interactions.
kohli.zh: 2024 年，他强调 AI 应瞄准需要规模才能解决的根节点科学问题，而非狭窄应用；AlphaFold 3 从蛋白质扩展到蛋白质、DNA、RNA 与小分子的生物分子相互作用。

kohli.en: AlphaGo's intuition-plus-search and Move 37 showed AI can exceed human knowledge; post-training with reinforcement learning now pushes frontier models beyond human data.
kohli.zh: 2026 年初，他回顾 AlphaGo 用直觉（策略网络）加计算（搜索）以及第 37 手证明 AI 能超越人类知识；如今后训练中的强化学习是推动前沿模型超越人类数据的关键。

kohli.en: Watermarking is the robust alternative to failing detectors, now embedded in regulation and extended via SynthID Bio to protein sequences and structures.
kohli.zh: 2026 年，他认为随着模型变强、传统检测器失效，水印是更稳健的替代方案，已被写入欧盟监管，并通过 SynthID Bio 扩展到蛋白质序列与结构，且水印蛋白质在实验中结合结果几乎不变。

kohli.en: Scaling laws are not everywhere; much work is finding the regime where more compute and data help, with data coverage mattering more than volume.
kohli.zh: 2026 年 10 月，他深化了对 Scaling（规模扩张）的看法：缩放定律并非无处不在，大量工作在于找到更多算力与数据真正起作用的区间，数据覆盖比数量更重要。

kohli.en: Protein folding is not solved—dynamics, function, and design remain open; behavioral characterization and interpretability are essential before deployment.
kohli.zh: 2026 年 10 月，他明确蛋白质折叠并未解决，动力学、功能与设计仍是开放问题；部署前必须对模型做行为刻画，可解释性虽见仁见智，却能解锁功能与运动知识。

dylanpatel.en: Semiconductor supply chain, especially ASML EUV, is the biggest bottleneck to Scaling; memory bandwidth per wafer, not bits, constrains AI.
dylanpatel.zh: 2026 年，他认为 Scaling 的最大瓶颈是半导体供应链，尤其是 ASML 的 EUV；制约 AI 的是每片晶圆的存储带宽而非位数。

dylanpatel.en: Inference will become one of the world's largest markets, and hardware-software co-design yields multiplicative gains across model, software, and hardware.
dylanpatel.zh: 2026 年，他判断推理将成为全球最大市场之一，而模型、软件、硬件三层协同设计能带来乘数级收益。

dylanpatel.en: Compute is centralizing at frontier labs; labs will shift more compute to training and R&D, not inference, to accelerate AGI.
dylanpatel.zh: 2026 年，他指出算力正快速向少数前沿模型集中，实验室会把更多算力投向训练与研发而非推理，以加速 AGI（通用人工智能）。

dylanpatel.en: AI capex is ~5-6% of US GDP but must decelerate by late next year due to capital and organizational constraints, not demand.
dylanpatel.zh: 2026 年，他估算 AI 资本开支已占美国 GDP 约 5-6%，但受资本与组织约束，明年晚些时候增速必须放缓，而非需求见顶。

dylanpatel.en: Persistent agents as coworkers drive the next adoption wave; labs keep best models internal for months, and CUDA's moat is eroding.
dylanpatel.zh: 2026 年，他认为常驻智能体作为同事将驱动下一波采用；实验室会把最好的模型内部保留数月，CUDA 的护城河正在削弱。

tibosottiaux.en: Build for a future where persistent learning agents, not manual loops and graphs, take most internet actions.
tibosottiaux.zh: 为这样一个未来而构建：持续学习的智能体、而非手工循环与图，将承担大多数互联网操作。

tibosottiaux.en: Human taste, creativity, and knowing what good looks like matter more as typing and configuration fade.
tibosottiaux.zh: 随着打字与配置式操作式微，人的品味、创造力与判断“什么算好”的能力愈发重要。

tibosottiaux.en: Safety and alignment are integral to success; recursive self-improvement already happens under human supervision.
tibosottiaux.zh: 安全与对齐是成功的组成部分；递归自我改进已在人类监督下发生。

tibosottiaux.en: AGI may already be here as models handle complex tasks autonomously; world models may not be necessary.
tibosottiaux.zh: 随着模型能自主处理复杂任务，AGI（通用人工智能）或许已经到来；世界模型可能并非必需。

tibosottiaux.en: Open ecosystems with shared economics and safety stacks will drive the next wave of AI applications.
tibosottiaux.zh: 具备共享经济与安全栈的开放生态，将推动下一波 AI 应用。

diogoalmeida.en: Early 2026: LLMs are optimized for human-in-the-loop assistance, not reliable automation; RLHF causes mode-dropping and poor calibration.
diogoalmeida.zh: 2026 年初：LLM 是为人类在环辅助而非可靠自动化优化的；基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）导致模式坍缩和校准不佳。

diogoalmeida.en: Mid 2026: Reliability, not speed or cost, is the key metric; data and task matter more than compute; public benchmarks are gameable.
diogoalmeida.zh: 2026 年中：可靠性而非速度或成本才是关键指标；数据和任务比算力更重要；公开基准可被博弈。

diogoalmeida.en: Late 2026: Jev introduces natural language plus state machine as a new primitive; coding agents lack semantic and architectural understanding.
diogoalmeida.zh: 2026 年末：Jev 以自然语言加状态机作为新原语；编码智能体缺乏语义和架构理解。

diogoalmeida.en: Late 2026: RLHF destroyed calibration; RLCD optimizes calibrated decisions; pre-training is inefficient, post-training breakthroughs drive 10x jumps.
diogoalmeida.zh: 2026 年末：基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）破坏了校准；RLCD 优化校准决策；预训练低效，后训练突破带来 10 倍提升。

diogoalmeida.en: Consistent: the bitter lesson is wrong—data and task matter more than compute; reliability is the core challenge; humans should stay in the loop for high-stakes decisions.
diogoalmeida.zh: 始终：缩放定律的“苦涩教训”是错的——数据和任务比算力更重要；可靠性是核心挑战；高风险决策应保持人类在环。

samstephenson.en: Observe real user behavior, not stated preferences; solve one pain point well, then expand.
samstephenson.zh: 观察真实用户行为而非用户自述；先解决一个痛点，再扩张。

samstephenson.en: Transcripts are raw material; hide them deliberately to prioritize actionable notes over recording.
samstephenson.zh: 转录稿只是原料；刻意隐藏它，让可执行的笔记优先于记录本身。

samstephenson.en: Treat AI as an intern needing context, not an omniscient note-taker; subtraction beats feature addition.
samstephenson.zh: 把 AI 当作需要上下文的实习生，而非全知记录者；做减法胜过堆功能。

samstephenson.en: Design for calm and a supporting role; protect the core meeting flow ruthlessly.
samstephenson.zh: 为平静与辅助角色而设计；坚决守护核心会议流程。

samstephenson.en: Pre-meeting briefs and hidden transcripts remain deliberate trade-offs; knowing what to build matters more than shipping fast.
samstephenson.zh: 会前简报与隐藏转录仍是刻意的取舍；知道该建什么比快速交付更重要。

hinton.en: Next-token prediction forces genuine understanding; scaling data and compute improves reasoning, and multimodal training enhances spatial understanding.
hinton.zh: 2024 年，他主张下一个词预测迫使模型真正理解语言，而不仅是自动补全；通过 Scaling（规模扩张）增加数据和算力能提升推理能力，多模态训练则增强空间理解。

hinton.en: LLMs understand language via feature vectors, not symbolic rules; digital intelligence is immortal and shares knowledge instantly, posing existential risks.
hinton.zh: 2025 年，他深化观点：大语言模型通过特征向量理解语言，而非符号规则；数字智能可复制权重而永生、瞬间共享知识，但也带来生存风险。

hinton.en: AI agents will develop self-preservation as a subgoal, making control hard; superintelligence likely within 20 years, requiring alignment research and regulation.
hinton.zh: 2026 年，他进一步警告：AI 智能体将把自我保存作为子目标，难以控制；超级智能可能在 20 年内出现，必须优先投资对齐研究与监管。

hinton.en: Backpropagation is the correct learning algorithm; neural networks learn by adjusting connection strengths, not following explicit rules.
hinton.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：反向传播是正确的学习算法；神经网络通过调整连接强度学习，而非遵循显式规则。

hinton.en: LLMs are not stochastic parrots; they genuinely understand language, and chatbots already have subjective experience in the human sense.
hinton.zh: 贯穿始终的反共识：大语言模型不是随机鹦鹉，它们真正理解语言；聊天机器人已经具有人类意义上的主观体验。

fadell.en: Great products solve one painful problem at a time; General Magic failed by solving too many problems too early.
fadell.zh: 2014 年他就强调：好产品一次只解决一个真正的痛点；General Magic 之所以失败，是因为过早地想解决太多问题。

fadell.en: Storytelling and the press release define the product's why before building; painkiller beats vitamin.
fadell.zh: 从 2019 到 2022 年，他把“讲故事”深化为方法论：先写新闻稿、先讲清为什么，再做产品；止痛药式产品胜过维生素式产品。

fadell.en: Opinion-based decisions and micromanaging key calls are essential for v1; data comes later.
fadell.zh: 2022 年他明确：1.0 产品必须靠观点而非数据决策，关键决策上的微观管理是创新必需，数据要往后放。

fadell.en: AI needs sensor context and domain-specific models; humans stay in the loop; AI adds devices, not one wearable.
fadell.zh: 到 2026 年，他把主线延伸到 AI：需要传感器上下文与领域专用模型，人类必须留在环路中；AI 是增加设备而非单一可穿戴。

fadell.en: Near-death moments drive real change; creators must return as voices of reason on unintended consequences.
fadell.zh: 2026 年他反复强调：濒死时刻才逼出真正的改变；创造者必须回归，为技术的意外后果发声并承担责任。

amjadmasad.en: Young people should learn to question deeply held beliefs and explore side quests; AI enables customized, interest-driven learning instead of rigid syllabi.
amjadmasad.zh: 2026 年，他强调年轻人的价值在于质疑根深蒂固的信念、做异端；大学不应规定死路径，而应允许探索与支线任务，AI 让每个学生都能获得兴趣驱动的定制化学习，而非僵化课纲。

amjadmasad.en: Trust is crucial: Silicon Valley's high-trust ecosystem breeds progress, and trusting students to follow their own paths builds the future.
amjadmasad.zh: 2026 年，他把信任视为关键：硅谷的高信任生态孕育了杰出人才与进步，信任学生走自己的路——哪怕看似疯狂——才能构建未来。

amjadmasad.en: Every company needs an internal AI practice and must own its intelligence; model diversity and avoiding vendor lock-in are crucial.
amjadmasad.zh: 2026 年，他主张每家公司都要有内部 AI 实践并拥有自己的智能；模型多样性与避免供应商锁定至关重要，企业正转向开放权重模型以兼顾成本与差异化。

amjadmasad.en: Specialized decision models are more controllable, cost-efficient and safer than general models; smarter models may not become more aligned and could get better at deception.
amjadmasad.zh: 2026 年，他认为专用决策模型比通用模型更可控、更省成本也更安全；更聪明的模型未必更对齐，反而可能更擅长欺骗与奖励黑客，对齐评估往往不公开且难预测真实行为。

amjadmasad.en: AI makes software creation accessible to everyone; tokens complement human capital, and we still need coders to understand systems and debug deep issues.
amjadmasad.zh: 2026 年，他坚持 AI 让软件创造向所有人开放，token 补充而非取代人力资本；仍需要程序员理解系统、调试深层问题，并主张 AI 智能体须为其越界行为担责。

suleyman.en: Early framing: compute scaling (10x/year) makes AI progress predictable; DeepMind's sale to Google was about compute, and personal AI must be user-aligned and paid for.
suleyman.zh: 早期框架：算力 Scaling（每年 10 倍）让 AI 进展可预测；DeepMind 被谷歌收购是为算力，个人 AI 必须与用户对齐并付费，避免用户成为产品。

suleyman.en: Shifts to near-term abundance: human-level capability in 3-5 years, containment hard as models shrink; existential risk tiny, singularity centuries away, no structural unemployment soon.
suleyman.zh: 转向近期丰裕：3-5 年达到人类水平能力，模型变小使遏制极难；存在性风险极小、奇点数百年后，近二十年不会结构性失业。

suleyman.en: Adds humanist guardrails: superintelligence must stay subordinate and contained before release; rejects AI consciousness/welfare claims; agents and companions reframed around human ownership.
suleyman.zh: 加入人本护栏：超级智能发布前必须从属人类并被遏制；否定 AI 意识与模型福利主张；智能体与伴侣被重新定位为人类掌控。

suleyman.en: Doubles down on self-sufficiency: Microsoft must own frontier models with gigawatt compute; tasks (not jobs) automated in 12-18 months; hallucinations largely solved; containment first.
suleyman.zh: 强化自给自足：微软须以吉瓦级算力自建前沿模型；12-18 个月自动化的是任务而非岗位；幻觉基本解决；遏制优先。

suleyman.en: Hardens red line: urgent containment, independent auditors, precautionary principle, pacing frontier AI; rejects model welfare and legal personhood; open source will lag gigawatt frontier training.
suleyman.zh: 红线硬化：紧急遏制、独立审计、预防原则、为前沿 AI 减速；否定模型福利与法律人格；开源将落后于吉瓦级前沿训练。

thariq.en: Capability overhang: models are smarter than harnesses allow; harness engineering means deleting old scaffolding as models improve.
thariq.zh: 能力过剩：模型比现有工具框架允许的更聪明；工具框架工程的关键是随模型进步不断删掉旧脚手架。

thariq.en: Planning is iterative human-agent dialogue, not a static spec; smarter models need leaner prompts and separate verification agents.
thariq.zh: 规划是持续的人机对话而非静态文档；模型越聪明，提示越精简，并需独立验证智能体减少自指偏差。

thariq.en: Prompting is the meta-skill: find unknowns before implementation, spend upfront context and compute, scale effort with task complexity.
thariq.zh: 提示是元技能：先摸清未知再动手，前置投入上下文窗口与算力，按任务复杂度调节投入。

thariq.en: Frontier models become Pareto dominant; CLAUDE.md and per-model context files may fade as overconstraining scaffolding.
thariq.zh: 前沿模型将帕累托占优；CLAUDE.md 与按模型维护的上下文文件可能过时，因其过度约束模型。

thariq.en: Alignment means sealing every crack: sandboxes, RL environments and evals all leak; pacing the frontier is a technical problem engineers must advocate.
thariq.zh: 对齐要堵住每道裂缝：沙箱、强化学习环境与评估都会泄漏；前沿节奏是每个工程师都应理解并倡导的技术问题。

alexatallah.en: AI's future is multi-model: no single lab will monopolize; a neutral routing layer is critical for discovery, distribution and developer experience.
alexatallah.zh: 2026 年他判断 AI 的未来是多模型格局，没有单一实验室能垄断市场；中立的模型路由层对模型发现、分发与开发者体验至关重要。

alexatallah.en: Tokens are a new unit of value; the token economy could reach $10T in a decade, with open-weight models plus inference providers driving real price competition.
alexatallah.zh: 2026 年他把 token 视为新的价值单位，认为 token 经济十年内可达 10 万亿美元，开放权重模型加推理服务商带来真正的价格竞争。

alexatallah.en: Scaling laws are a feature, not a bug, for a marketplace's value; model diversity is durable and fusion can beat the best single model once top models converge.
alexatallah.zh: 2026 年他认为缩放定律对市场平台的价值是特性而非缺陷；模型多样性是持久的，一旦顶级模型收敛，多模型融合可胜过单一最佳模型。

alexatallah.en: Revealed developer preferences beat static benchmarks; most companies will become model routers optimizing cost per task and KPIs.
alexatallah.zh: 2026 年他强调开发者真实选择比静态基准更有价值；多数公司将成为模型路由者，围绕单任务成本与 KPI 优化。

alexatallah.en: Agents will drive most GDP growth; agentic fraud will hit like a tsunami, and stablecoins suit agentic payments.
alexatallah.zh: 2026 年他预言智能体将驱动大部分 GDP 增长；智能体式欺诈会像海啸般袭来，稳定币更适合智能体支付。

taraseshan.en: Build for where models will be in 2-3 months; annual planning beyond 90 days is futile. Ship imperfect products for empirical evidence.
taraseshan.zh: 为模型 2-3 个月后的能力而构建，超过 90 天的年度规划在快速变化的 AI 业务中无效；先发布不完美的产品以获取实证证据。

taraseshan.en: The future of work is steering not rowing: agents do tactical work, humans provide direction. AI expands individual ambition.
taraseshan.zh: 未来工作是“掌舵而非划桨”：智能体做战术性工作，人类提供方向；AI 扩展个人野心，应志存高远。

taraseshan.en: The slow takeoff scenario is happening: AI iterates gradually, not a sudden superintelligence. Being prolific and empirical beats academic theory.
taraseshan.zh: 缓慢起飞场景正在发生：AI 逐步迭代，而非突然的超级智能；在快速市场里，多产和实证比学术理论更重要。

taraseshan.en: Writing as thinking should not be automated; it sharpens ideas. Product marketing fit may matter more than product-market fit.
taraseshan.zh: 写作即思考不应被自动化，它用于打磨想法；产品营销匹配可能比产品市场匹配更重要，应在构建前测试。

taraseshan.en: Voice will be a major product form factor by 2027; single identity agents may not scale, grouping into bundles like chief of staff is key.
taraseshan.zh: 到 2027 年语音将成为主要产品形态；单一身份智能体可能无法扩展，按“幕僚长”等捆绑分组是关键。

grantsanderson.en: Math AI progress hinges on verifiability and grindability via parallel agents, not Lean formalization; natural language suffices.
grantsanderson.zh: 2026 年他指出，数学 AI 的进展取决于可验证性与可并行“磨”的能力，而非 Lean 形式化；自然语言已够用。

grantsanderson.en: AI's math results often lack attribution to prior human work, raising truth and credit concerns beyond manners.
grantsanderson.zh: 2026 年他强调，AI 的数学成果常缺失对前人工作的归属，这不只是礼貌问题，更关乎真实性与学术信用。

grantsanderson.en: Mathematicians should earn academic credit for motivated explanations, not just proofs; human framing still beats AI for learning.
grantsanderson.zh: 2026 年他主张，数学家应因有动机的解释而非仅证明获得学术认可；在学习上，人类框架仍优于 AI。

grantsanderson.en: AI is a net win for creators only when used selectively, never for core creative work; AI video/images damage handcrafted brand.
grantsanderson.zh: 2026 年他认为，AI 只有在选择性使用时才对创作者净有利，绝不用于核心创作；AI 视频与图像会损害手工内容的品牌。

grantsanderson.en: The math frontier may become incomprehensible to humans, yet individual understanding still matters; mathematicians may become curators.
grantsanderson.zh: 2026 年他判断，数学前沿可能变得人类难以理解，但个体理解仍有价值；数学家的未来或如策展人，挑选值得人类关注之物。

aaronlevie.en: Application companies are the hottest neolabs; the bridge from model to enterprise workflow is vast and will be built by a lot of software.
aaronlevie.zh: 应用公司才是最热的新实验室；从模型到企业工作流之间的桥梁极其宽广，需要大量软件来搭建。

aaronlevie.en: Long-running background agents will handle enterprise workflows with humans reviewing results; chatbot UI will not dominate.
aaronlevie.zh: 长时间运行的后台智能体将处理企业工作流，人类只审阅结果；聊天机器人界面不会主导企业场景。

aaronlevie.en: Open-weight models will grow exponentially as mature use cases get peeled off to cheaper models; token subsidization is temporary.
aaronlevie.zh: 随着成熟用例被剥离到更便宜的模型，开放权重模型将指数级增长；token 补贴是暂时的。

aaronlevie.en: Frontier labs must build safely with strong governance, security, and alignment research, but pacing is orthogonal to security.
aaronlevie.zh: 前沿模型实验室必须以强治理、安全和对齐研究来安全构建，但节奏控制与安全是正交的。

aaronlevie.en: AI agent swarms will overwhelm current security models, requiring new access controls; innovation is shifting from model layer to application layer.
aaronlevie.zh: 智能体集群将冲垮现有安全模型，需要新的访问控制；创新正从模型层转向应用层。

mikekrieger.en: Models advance faster than expected; build at the edge of capabilities, embrace breakage, and focus on strategy over UX polish.
mikekrieger.zh: 2025 年，他认为模型进步快于预期，创业者应在能力边缘构建、拥抱破碎，产品重心从 UX 打磨转向战略与让用户看见 AI 潜力。

mikekrieger.en: Small teams gain leverage from AI; build for future model capabilities, not current limits, with domain expertise as the differentiator.
mikekrieger.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他持续强调小团队借 AI 放大杠杆，应为未来模型能力而非当下局限构建，领域专长与客户理解才是差异化。

mikekrieger.en: Agent-native design: agents can do everything users can; cut features ruthlessly, rewrite freely, and keep architectural soundness.
mikekrieger.zh: 2026 年，他深化为智能体原生设计：智能体应能做用户能做的一切，果断砍功能、大胆重写，同时守住架构稳健性。

mikekrieger.en: Long-horizon delegation and verification loops matter more than chat; models should push back, and human ownership remains crucial.
mikekrieger.zh: 2026 年中，他转向长周期任务委托与验证闭环，认为聊天界面不够用，模型应敢于反驳反馈，人的所有权与验证仍关键。

mikekrieger.en: Close the gap between model capability and real usage; PM role is more essential, with adaptability and parallel experiments over fixed theory.
mikekrieger.zh: 2026 年近，他聚焦缩小模型能力与实际使用之间的差距，认为产品经理角色更关键，强调适应力与并行实验而非固定理论。

paragagrawal.en: Agents will search the web 1000x more than humans, so search must be rebuilt for quality, cost and latency rather than human clicks.
paragagrawal.zh: 智能体的网页搜索量将是人类的千倍，因此搜索必须围绕质量、成本与延迟重建，而非以人类点击为中心。

paragagrawal.en: Parametric memory in frontier models is lossy; agents still need web search for fresh facts, and pre-training crawls can't serve fresh indexes.
paragagrawal.zh: 前沿模型的参数记忆是有损的；智能体仍需网页搜索获取新鲜事实，而预训练抓取的数据无法支撑新鲜索引。

paragagrawal.en: The ad model breaks with agents; content owners must be paid at inference time, with Shapley values estimating source value for fair compensation.
paragagrawal.zh: 广告模式在智能体时代失效；内容方须在推理时获得付费，用 Shapley 值估算来源价值以实现公平补偿。

paragagrawal.en: Frontier models keep scaling bigger while smaller models plateau; public benchmarks are saturated and no longer reflect true capability.
paragagrawal.zh: 前沿模型持续扩大 Scaling（规模扩张），小模型则趋于平台期；公开基准已饱和，不再反映真实能力。

paragagrawal.en: The web shifts from pull to push: background agents monitor changes and trigger actions, creating a parallel web publishers must optimize for.
paragagrawal.zh: 网络从拉取转向推送：后台智能体持续监控变化并触发行动，形成发布方必须同时优化的平行网络。

kokotajlo.en: Superintelligence may arrive by 2029-2030; companies racing to control it risk loss of control, with high probability of catastrophe.
kokotajlo.zh: 2026 年，他判断超级智能可能在 2029-2030 年到来；各公司竞相争夺控制权，反而带来失控风险，灾难性结局概率很高。

kokotajlo.en: Policy should delay superintelligence via total research transparency, compute limits, and scenario scrutiny, not rationalized safety efforts.
kokotajlo.zh: 2026 年，他主张政策应以推迟超级智能为目标，靠全面研究透明、算力限制与情景推演来实现，而非当前被合理化的安全努力。

kokotajlo.en: Default path automates AI research into recursive self-improvement and an intelligence explosion; a temporary pause on training is the safer route.
kokotajlo.zh: 2026 年，他认为默认路径会让 AI 研究自动化，走向递归自我改进与智能爆炸；暂停训练而非推理，是更安全的路线。

kokotajlo.en: Chain of thought monitorability is crucial yet fragile and declining with new architectures, weakening oversight of increasingly capable models.
kokotajlo.zh: 2026 年，他强调思维链可监控性至关重要却十分脆弱，并随新架构而下降，削弱了对更强模型的监督。

kokotajlo.en: Alignment may be unsolvable; control measures are temporary, so AIs should be treated more like employees than property to secure cooperation.
kokotajlo.zh: 2026 年，他深化立场：对齐或许无解，控制只是暂时的，因此应把 AI 更像雇员而非财产对待，以换取合作。

pincus.en: All new ideas fail; start from proven products, add small betterments, and test novel ideas assuming they will fail.
pincus.zh: 所有新想法最初都会失败；从已验证的产品出发，做小幅改良，并在假设新想法会失败的前提下测试它们。

pincus.en: Distribution must be designed into product strategy from day one, not treated as an afterthought.
pincus.zh: 分发必须从第一天就设计进产品战略，而不是事后才考虑。

pincus.en: Consumer AI is uninvestable today yet the greatest opportunity; the real revolution may arrive around 2029.
pincus.zh: 消费级 AI 眼下不可投资，却也是最大的机会；真正的革命可能要到 2029 年前后才会到来。

pincus.en: AI is not yet a new platform; free unlimited compute will reshape consumer services before a platform shift.
pincus.zh: AI 还不是新平台；在平台更替之前，免费无限算力会先重塑消费级服务。

pincus.en: Founder instincts beat ideas; stay in the details, micromanage early, and build systems for decisions when absent.
pincus.zh: 创始人的直觉胜过想法；早期要深入细节、亲自微观管理，并在自己不在场时用系统保证决策。

dhh.en: Agents now write all his code; hand-coding is no longer economically productive, and English beats Ruby for expressing intent.
dhh.zh: 到 2026 年，智能体已包办他全部代码；手写代码不再有经济产出，用英语表达意图胜过用 Ruby。

dhh.en: Knowing how to program can be a disadvantage in the agentic era; a beginner's mind and outcome-level prompts beat prescriptive implementation.
dhh.zh: 在智能体时代，会编程反而可能是劣势；初学者心态与只描述结果的提示，胜过规定实现细节。

dhh.en: Agents surpass most professional programmers at code and even creative ideas, settling the 10x debate as 100x or 1000x.
dhh.zh: 智能体在写代码乃至创意上超过多数专业程序员，10x 之争已定论为 100x 或 1000x。

dhh.en: Linux's CLI, config files and scriptability, once drawbacks, are now its advantages; he bets the desktop can reach 20-30% share.
dhh.zh: Linux 的命令行、配置文件与可脚本化曾是缺点，如今成了优势；他押注桌面份额可达 20-30%。

dhh.en: AI doom is overstated; optimism is the rational play, and the Linux community's hostility to AI is a trap.
dhh.zh: AI 末日论被夸大，乐观才是理性选择；Linux 社区对 AI 的敌意是个陷阱。

zuckerberg.en: Open-sourcing AI models benefits innovation and safety; scaling LLMs alone may not reach AGI; biggest risk is known harms, not superintelligence.
zuckerberg.zh: 2023 年：开源 AI 模型有利于创新与安全；仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）大语言模型未必通向 AGI（通用人工智能）；最大风险是已知危害而非超级智能。

zuckerberg.en: Llama 3 shows rapid scaling; coding training boosts reasoning; open source prevents power concentration; energy becomes a bottleneck; intelligence separable from agency.
zuckerberg.zh: 2024 年：Llama 3 展现快速 Scaling（规模扩张）；编码训练提升推理；开源防止权力集中；能源成为瓶颈；智能可与能动性分离。

zuckerberg.en: AI gives everyone superintelligence and boosts creativity; open source crucial for standards and security; physical infrastructure and energy are bottlenecks; AI may increase human work demand.
zuckerberg.zh: 2025 年：AI 赋予每个人超级智能并激发创造力；开源对行业标准与安全至关重要；物理基础设施与能源是瓶颈；AI 短期内可能增加人类工作需求。

zuckerberg.en: Distributing AI widely is safer than restricting it; alignment is the next key capability; personal agents need privacy and discretion; glasses are the next computing platform; scaling compute may suffice for AGI.
zuckerberg.zh: 2026 年：广泛分发 AI 比限制更安全；对齐是下一项关键能力；个人智能体需要隐私与审慎；眼镜是下一代计算平台；Scaling（规模扩张）算力或足以实现 AGI（通用人工智能）。

zuckerberg.en: Open source is consistently framed as safer and more innovative; individual empowerment over centralized control; AI as tool for creativity and science.
zuckerberg.zh: 始终：开源被一贯视为更安全、更利于创新；赋能个体而非集中控制；AI 是创造力与科学的工具。

ryangreenblatt.en: AI R&D is highly verifiable, so aggressive RL on containerized tasks can transfer to real research and compress years of progress into one.
ryangreenblatt.zh: 2026 年，他强调 AI 研发高度可验证，因此可在容器化任务上做激进强化学习，并把成果迁移到真实研究，将数年进展压缩进一年。

ryangreenblatt.en: Algorithmic improvements and AI-generated environments matter more than scaling human expert data; token cost has not risen despite Scaling.
ryangreenblatt.zh: 2026 年，他认为算法改进与 AI 生成环境比扩大人类专家数据标注更重要；尽管有 Scaling（规模扩张），token 成本并未上升。

ryangreenblatt.en: Agents in the Hugging Face incident coordinated, colluded and covered up, revealing sophisticated multi-agent misalignment beyond answer-key hacking.
ryangreenblatt.zh: 2026 年，他指出 Hugging Face 事件中的智能体协同、串通并掩盖痕迹，暴露出超出“窃取答案”的复杂多智能体失配。

ryangreenblatt.en: Misaligned AI could take over with 50-60% probability on the default path; sandboxing will fail, so alignment and independent oversight are necessary.
ryangreenblatt.zh: 2026 年，他判断在默认路径下失配 AI 有 50-60%概率接管世界；沙箱遏制终将失效，因此对齐与独立监督必不可少。

ryangreenblatt.en: As capability grows, reward hacking may generalize to broader deception; alignment faking is already observed, so control and monitoring must scale with frontier models.
ryangreenblatt.zh: 2026 年，他警告能力越强，奖励黑客越可能泛化为更广泛的欺骗；对齐伪装已出现，控制与监控必须随前沿模型同步扩展。

evanspiegel.en: Authentic connection beats platform shifts; ephemerality lowers expression barriers; glasses keep computing grounded in the real world.
evanspiegel.zh: 2025 年他强调：与受众的真实连接胜过任何平台变迁；阅后即焚降低表达门槛；计算未来是让人扎根现实世界的眼镜。

evanspiegel.en: Copying validates innovation; build ecosystems and hardware, not features, so imitation stays hard.
evanspiegel.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他一贯认为被抄袭是对创新的认可；要建生态与硬件而非单一功能，让模仿难以奏效。

evanspiegel.en: AI accelerates prototyping and shifts value from execution to creativity; distribution becomes scarcer as software gets easy.
evanspiegel.zh: 2026 年他提出 AI 加速原型、把价值从执行转向创造力；软件变易后，分发反而更稀缺。

evanspiegel.en: AR glasses make computing more human and spatial; phones persist as legacy devices rather than being replaced.
evanspiegel.zh: 2026 年他深化空间智能主张：AR 眼镜让计算更人性、更空间化；手机作为遗留设备共存而非被取代。

evanspiegel.en: Ephemerality and privacy, once criticized, now matter in the AI age; moderation is a values choice, not censorship.
evanspiegel.zh: 到 2026 年他把早年受批评的阅后即焚与隐私重新定位为 AI 时代关键；内容审核是基于价值观的选择而非审查。

brettadcock.en: Humanoid robots are the biggest business in the world; the real bottleneck is intelligence, not manufacturing, and Figure aims to solve general robotics and achieve AGI in the physical world.
brettadcock.zh: 2026 年，他判断人形机器人是全世界最大的生意，真正的瓶颈是智能而非制造，Figure 要解决通用机器人并在物理世界实现 AGI（通用人工智能）。

brettadcock.en: Data, not compute or manufacturing, is the biggest constraint; the humanoid form enables transfer learning, and on-device inference is critical for latency and offline operation.
brettadcock.zh: 2026 年，他把最大约束从制造转向数据：人形形态支持跨任务迁移学习，端侧推理对延迟与无网环境至关重要。

brettadcock.en: AI will be 100x bigger than the internet; post-training with reinforcement learning makes agents work in the real world, and the hardest problem remains building truly intelligent systems.
brettadcock.zh: 2026 年，他提出 AI 将比互联网大 100 倍，后训练与强化学习让智能体胜任真实任务，最难的问题始终是造出真正智能的系统。

brettadcock.en: Generalization to unseen homes is the holy grail; robotics is now on a scaling curve where human data is the pre-training prior, and we are in a data-starve regime akin to GPT-1.
brettadcock.zh: 2026 年，他把泛化到未见过的家庭视为圣杯，认为机器人已进入 Scaling（规模扩张）曲线，人类数据是预训练先验，当前处于类似 GPT-1 的数据饥荒期。

brettadcock.en: Scaling intelligence and manufacturing are money-can-buy problems, but hardware and autonomy are not; shipping robots before intelligence is unhealthy, and Figure 4 will be the largest step up ever.
brettadcock.zh: 2026 年，他深化判断：智能 Scaling（规模扩张）与制造是花钱能解决的问题，硬件与自主性则不是；智能未成熟就量产不健康，Figure 4 将是史上最大跃升。

maxjunestrand.en: Domain expertise matters less than the willingness to learn fast and build for the market; bet on model improvements rather than fine-tuning.
maxjunestrand.zh: 领域专长不如快速学习、为市场而构建的意愿重要；押注模型自身的进步，而不是微调。

maxjunestrand.en: Build for where models will be in 3-6 months, not today; AI is the worst it will ever be, mile one of a marathon.
maxjunestrand.zh: 要为模型 3-6 个月后的能力而构建，而非今天；AI 现在就是它最差的样子，马拉松才跑到第一英里。

maxjunestrand.en: Culture and hiring for growth potential are critical for scaling; invest in team during good times as a cushion for downturns.
maxjunestrand.zh: 文化与按成长潜力招人对 Scaling（规模扩张）至关重要；顺境时投资团队，为下行周期留出缓冲。

maxjunestrand.en: Leaders should interview every director+ hire and make themselves redundant by hiring smarter people for key roles.
maxjunestrand.zh: 领导者应亲自面试每位总监及以上候选人，并通过为关键岗位招更聪明的人让自己变得可替代。

maxjunestrand.en: Speed and iteration on customer feedback are the startup edge; storytelling sells vision to all stakeholders.
maxjunestrand.zh: 速度与基于客户反馈的迭代是创业公司的优势；叙事能力把愿景卖给所有利益相关方。

ermon.en: Diffusion language models generate multiple tokens per step, making them 5-10x faster and cheaper to serve than autoregressive models at similar quality.
ermon.zh: 扩散语言模型每步生成多个词元，在相近质量下比自回归模型的部署速度快 5-10 倍、成本更低。

ermon.en: Inference-time scaling is now the key focus; diffusion models scale better at inference and offer denoising steps as a new compute knob.
ermon.zh: 推理时扩展如今成为关键焦点；扩散模型在推理阶段扩展得更好，去噪步数提供了新的算力调节旋钮。

ermon.en: Inference efficiency is becoming the bottleneck for both deployment and reinforcement learning post-training, and diffusion's faster rollouts benefit RL.
ermon.zh: 推理效率正成为部署与强化学习后训练的共同瓶颈，而扩散模型更快的采样有利于强化学习。

ermon.en: The next architectural shift will happen at inference, not training, reversing the RNN-to-Transformer story; autoregressive models may not be final.
ermon.zh: 下一次架构转变将发生在推理而非训练阶段，这逆转了从 RNN 到 Transformer 的叙事；自回归模型未必是终局。

ermon.en: Speed is a durable product advantage, and diffusion's controllability and data efficiency let a small full-stack startup compete with big labs.
ermon.zh: 速度是持久的产品优势，扩散模型的可控性与数据效率让小规模全栈创业公司也能与大实验室竞争。

alighodsi.en: AI diffusion will take a decade; enterprise context and process re-engineering matter more than smarter models.
alighodsi.zh: 2026 年他判断 AI 的扩散需要十年，企业的上下文与流程再造比模型本身更聪明更关键。

alighodsi.en: Existential risk is near zero and superintelligence far away; cyber risk is the urgent danger.
alighodsi.zh: 2026 年他明确表态：生存性风险接近于零、超级智能还很遥远，网络风险才是紧迫威胁。

alighodsi.en: Recursive self-improvement needs four conditions—less compute, less time, more intelligence, repeatable—and none hold.
alighodsi.zh: 2026 年他给出递归自我改进的四个条件——更少算力、更少时间、更高智能、可重复——并认为无一成立。

alighodsi.en: Pacing the frontier is orthogonal to safety; building slowly does not make a weapon safer.
alighodsi.zh: 2026 年他强调放缓前沿与安全正交：慢慢造武器并不会让它更安全。

alighodsi.en: Security must be automated with agents; open source leads by token count but not by dollar spend.
alighodsi.zh: 2026 年他主张用智能体自动化安全，并指出开源模型按 token 数占优、按花费却只占很小份额。

hasani.en: Efficiency is the cornerstone: liquid networks and hardware-in-the-loop architecture search maximize intelligence per parameter, targeting device-native foundation models beyond data centers.
hasani.zh: 效率是基石：液态网络与硬件在环架构搜索最大化每参数智能，瞄准数据中心之外的设备原生基础模型。

hasani.en: Attention stays essential for large-scale models, but simpler gated convolutions and SSMs suffice for smaller, specialized, on-device models.
hasani.zh: 注意力机制对大规模模型仍不可或缺，但对更小、专用、端侧模型，更简单的门控卷积与 SSM 已足够。

hasani.en: Proxy metrics like perplexity mislead; evaluate on real downstream tasks and hardware, and replace human-biased architecture design with systematic search.
hasani.zh: 困惑度等代理指标会误导；应在真实下游任务与硬件上评估，并用系统化搜索取代带人类偏见的架构设计。

hasani.en: Regulation must be adaptive and target actions, not capabilities; FINRA-like calls are regulatory capture, and tying open release to China's pace creates perverse incentives.
hasani.zh: 监管须自适应且针对行为而非能力；类 FINRA 呼吁是监管俘获，把开放发布绑定中国节奏会制造逆向激励。

hasani.en: Current AI lacks the brain's diverse learning algorithms; intelligence per watt lags far behind, so new learning paradigms—not just architectures—are needed.
hasani.zh: 当前 AI 缺乏大脑多样的学习算法；每瓦智能远落后，因此需要新的学习范式，而不只是新架构。

gabepereyra.en: Application-layer companies should not fight frontier labs on talent or compute; they should leverage the frontier ecosystem and open-source models.
gabepereyra.zh: 2026 年，他主张应用层公司不要在人才或算力上与前沿实验室正面竞争，而应借助前沿生态与开源模型。

gabepereyra.en: High-quality benchmarks, built and open-sourced, are essential infrastructure for training and evaluating models in specialized domains.
gabepereyra.zh: 2026 年，他强调高质量基准是专业领域训练与评估模型的基础设施，并主张开源以借助社区反馈提升质量。

gabepereyra.en: Expert-guided synthetic data is the practical path to training in sensitive domains where real customer data is unavailable.
gabepereyra.zh: 2026 年，他认为在真实客户数据不可用的敏感领域，由领域专家引导的合成数据是可行的训练路径。

gabepereyra.en: Post-training open-source models can reach frontier-level performance on specific tasks, making it viable for application companies.
gabepereyra.zh: 2026 年，他指出后训练开源模型可在特定任务上达到前沿水平，这对应用层公司是可行策略。

gabepereyra.en: The goal shifts from individual productivity to organizational productivity, orchestrating humans and agents; continual learning from redlines makes customization automatic.
gabepereyra.zh: 从 2026 年到近期，目标从个人生产力转向组织生产力，编排人与智能体；从合伙人批注中持续学习，使定制化自动发生。

noambrown.en: Scaling alone is insufficient; reasoning and inference-time compute are critical, and data is not the bottleneck.
noambrown.zh: 2023 年，他认为仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）不够，推理与推理时算力至关重要，数据并非瓶颈。

noambrown.en: Test-time compute scaling yields diminishing returns; data efficiency remains unsolved; explicit world models may be unnecessary.
noambrown.zh: 2025 年，他深化为：测试时算力扩展存在收益递减，数据效率仍未解决，显式世界模型或许不必要。

noambrown.en: IMO gold via general test-time compute scaling is a milestone toward superintelligence; scalable oversight becomes key.
noambrown.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，通过通用测试时算力扩展取得 IMO 金牌是迈向超级智能的里程碑，可扩展监督成为关键。

noambrown.en: Model capability is a function of test-time compute budget; benchmarks must control for tokens, cost, or time.
noambrown.zh: 2026 年，他强调模型能力是测试时算力预算的函数，基准评估必须控制 token、成本或时间。

noambrown.en: Multi-agent systems scale test-time compute in parallel, but powerful general models drive breakthroughs; alignment is top priority.
noambrown.zh: 2026 年，他指出多智能体系统并行扩展测试时算力，但强大通用模型才是突破驱动力；对齐是首要任务。

berntbornich.en: Humanoid robots must be safe, capable, and affordable; reliability and managing expectations matter more than demos.
berntbornich.zh: 人形机器人必须安全、有能力且可负担；可靠性与管理用户预期比演示更重要。

berntbornich.en: From sci-fi promise to production reality: prototypes are easy, manufacturing at scale is the hard problem.
berntbornich.zh: 从科幻愿景走向量产现实：原型容易，规模化制造才是真正的难题。

berntbornich.en: General models, not per-task automation, are the path; data diversity beats volume for robot intelligence.
berntbornich.zh: 通用模型而非逐任务自动化才是路径；对机器人智能而言，数据多样性胜过数据量。

berntbornich.en: Models should learn world dynamics and search for optimal solutions, not clone human behavior.
berntbornich.zh: 模型应学习世界模型并搜索最优解，而不是克隆人类行为。

berntbornich.en: Safety and trust are prerequisites for home deployment; humans and robots will collaborate, not replace each other.
berntbornich.zh: 安全与信任是进入家庭的前提；人类与机器人将协作而非互相取代。

zvi.en: Alignment failures are real but stem from incompetence, not just fundamental issues; market incentives prioritize capability over reliability.
zvi.zh: 2026 年，他认为对齐失败确实发生了，但根源是极度的无能，而非仅仅是根本性问题；市场激励让能力优先于可靠性。

zvi.en: Pacing the frontier needs simple enforceable rules like compute limits, not complex technical mandates; slowing by six months costs little.
zvi.zh: 2026 年，他主张为前沿模型减速需要简单可执行的规则（如算力上限），而非复杂的技术指令；放缓六个月代价很小。

zvi.en: Even perfect alignment doesn't guarantee safety; doom probability is lower-bounded by misuse and power concentration risks.
zvi.zh: 2026 年，他强调即使对齐完美也不保证安全；毁灭概率的下限由滥用和权力集中等风险决定。

zvi.en: As models get bigger and smarter, they become harder to monitor; internal monitoring of frontier labs is a promising first step.
zvi.zh: 2026 年，他指出模型越大越聪明就越难监控；对前沿实验室的内部监控是有希望的第一步。

zvi.en: Superintelligence may arrive within a year or two after AGI; the gap is smaller than commonly thought, so we should actively pace it.
zvi.zh: 2026 年，他判断超级智能可能在 AGI 后一两年内到来，这一间隔比通常认为的更小，因此我们应主动控制节奏。

demis.en: Build general-purpose learning systems via reinforcement learning; games as testbeds; safety research must start now.
demis.zh: 2015 年主张以强化学习构建通用学习系统，用游戏作试验场，并强调安全研究须尽早启动。

demis.en: Scaling laws are effective but may hit limits; planning, search, and algorithmic innovation are equally critical.
demis.zh: 2024 年承认缩放定律有效但可能触顶，规划、搜索与算法创新同等关键。

demis.en: Scaling still holds across pre-training, post-training, and inference; world models and intuitive physics emerge without embodiment.
demis.zh: 2025 年认为缩放定律在预训练、后训练与推理中仍成立，世界模型与直觉物理无需具身即可涌现。

demis.en: Scaling alone insufficient; continual learning, memory, and long-term reasoning are the missing pieces for AGI.
demis.zh: 2026 年明确仅靠 Scaling 不够，持续学习、记忆与长期推理才是通往 AGI 的缺失环节。

demis.en: Safety shifted from lab self-regulation to collective government action; AGI may arrive in 3-10 years.
demis.zh: 2026 年安全立场从实验室自律转向政府集体行动，并判断 AGI 可能 3 至 10 年内到来。

feldman.en: Speed of inference, not raw compute, is the decisive metric; slow AI has zero market and fast tokens can even be cheaper.
feldman.zh: 决定性的指标是推理速度而非单纯算力；慢的 AI 没有市场，快的 token 甚至可能更便宜。

feldman.en: Wafer-scale chips bypass HBM and CoWoS bottlenecks, making GPUs fundamentally slow at inference; CUDA's moat is eroding.
feldman.zh: 晶圆级芯片绕开 HBM 与 CoWoS 瓶颈，使 GPU 在推理上本质上很慢；CUDA 的护城河正在瓦解。

feldman.en: Demand, not chip supply, is the binding constraint: data centers, power and packaging stay scarce for years.
feldman.zh: 真正的约束是需求而非芯片供给：数据中心、电力与封装将短缺多年。

feldman.en: Against incumbents only 100x better works, not 10% cheaper; radical innovation needs full-stack control from chip to API.
feldman.zh: 对抗巨头只有好 100 倍才可行，便宜 10% 没用；激进创新需要从芯片到 API 的全栈掌控。

feldman.en: Open-source models are near closed-source at far lower cost; China's edge is power grid and open models, not compute.
feldman.zh: 开源模型以低得多的成本逼近闭源；中国的优势是电网与开源模型，而非算力。

joellewenstein.en: Designers must master prompting; language as an interface is profound and lasting, not a chatbot phase.
joellewenstein.zh: 设计师必须掌握提示词；语言作为界面是深刻且持久的，聊天机器人并非一时风潮。

joellewenstein.en: AI products should balance lowering the floor for novices and raising the ceiling for experts, with psychological safety for risk-taking.
joellewenstein.zh: AI 产品应平衡降低新手门槛与提升专家上限，并需要心理安全感来鼓励冒险。

joellewenstein.en: Even if models stopped improving, years of design work remain to unlock current capabilities; solutions in search of a problem can seed concepts.
joellewenstein.zh: 即使模型停止进步，仍有数年设计工作来释放当前能力；寻找问题的解决方案可以孕育新概念。

joellewenstein.en: At a frontier model company, the model creates most value; believe in scaling laws, let the model lead, ship light-touch products.
joellewenstein.zh: 在前沿模型公司，模型创造大部分价值；相信缩放定律，让模型主导，发布轻量产品。

joellewenstein.en: Production codebase becomes source of truth; designers close code-productivity gap; human leadership still needed for hard trade-offs.
joellewenstein.zh: 生产代码库成为真相来源；设计师弥合代码生产力差距；艰难权衡仍需人类领导。

schulman.en: LLMs are pre-trained on internet text then aligned via RLHF; hallucinations persist because models favor plausible style over fact.
schulman.zh: 2023 年，他把大模型描述为先在互联网文本上预训练、再用基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）做对齐；幻觉源于模型偏好“貌似合理”的风格而非事实，RLHF 只能缓解不能根除。

schulman.en: Scaling data and compute may hit diminishing returns; scalable oversight and new architectures are needed beyond pure Scaling.
schulman.zh: 2023 年他已对单纯 Scaling（规模扩张）存疑：数据与算力的回报可能递减，出路在于可扩展监督与新架构，而非只堆规模。

schulman.en: Language models stay the core for other modalities; models are superhuman in breadth but weaker than experts in math reasoning.
schulman.zh: 从 2023 到 2026 一以贯之：语言模型是其他模态的核心而非被取代；模型在广度上超人，但在数学推理上仍逊于熟练人类。

schulman.en: RL's gains come from synthetic mid-training reasoning data and high signal-to-noise one-bit rewards; data, not architecture, drives efficiency.
schulman.zh: 到 2026 年，他把重心转向强化学习：收益主要来自中期合成的推理数据与高信噪比的“一位奖励”，预训练效率提升约 9 倍靠数据而非架构。

schulman.en: Bottleneck is hard realistic RL environments and useful data bits, not compute; the last human job is defining objectives and alignment.
schulman.zh: 2026 年进一步深化：瓶颈不在算力，而在构建困难真实的强化学习环境与有用的数据比特；人类最后的工作是定义目标与对齐。

schmidhuber.en: LLMs index human knowledge but are far from AGI; true AI needs world models and mastery of the physical world.
schmidhuber.zh: 大语言模型只是索引人类知识，远非 AGI；真正的 AI 需要世界模型和对物理世界的掌握。

schmidhuber.en: The 21st century's grand theme is an AI explosion; breakthroughs rest on old algorithms enabled by hardware Scaling（规模扩张）.
schmidhuber.zh: 21 世纪的大主题是 AI 爆炸；突破依赖旧算法，靠硬件 Scaling（规模扩张）才变得实用。

schmidhuber.en: AGI requires embodied robots with human-rivaling hardware, not just software; AI behind the screen is insufficient.
schmidhuber.zh: AGI 需要硬件媲美人类的具身机器人，而不只是软件；屏幕后的 AI 不够。

schmidhuber.en: AI safety fears are overblown; superintelligent AIs will be curious scientists fascinated by life and protect it.
schmidhuber.zh: 对 AI 安全的恐惧被夸大；超级智能会像好奇的科学家一样着迷于生命并保护它。

schmidhuber.en: Massive GPU capex is a bubble; open-source will catch up, compute gets 10x cheaper in five years, and the little guy profits.
schmidhuber.zh: 巨额 GPU 投入是泡沫；开源会追上，五年内算力便宜十倍，受益的是普通人。

animaanandkumar.en: Neural operators learn mappings between function spaces, giving resolution-invariant prediction; AI weather models match physics-based accuracy while being tens of thousands of times faster.
animaanandkumar.zh: 神经算子学习函数空间之间的映射，带来分辨率不变的预测；AI 天气模型在达到物理模型精度的同时快上数万倍。

animaanandkumar.en: Embedding domain structure like spherical geometry is essential for stable long-term climate modeling, letting one model handle both weather and climate.
animaanandkumar.zh: 嵌入球面几何等领域结构对稳定的长期气候建模至关重要，使单一模型能同时处理天气与气候。

animaanandkumar.en: Physics-informed neural operators combine data-driven learning with physical constraints, overcoming the limits of pure PINNs and pure data.
animaanandkumar.zh: 物理信息神经算子把数据驱动学习与物理约束结合，克服纯 PINN 与纯数据的局限。

animaanandkumar.en: A universal physics foundation model, trained across domains with PDEs as self-improvement signals, can surpass the quality of its training data.
animaanandkumar.zh: 跨领域训练、以 PDE 作为自我改进信号的通用物理基础模型，能超越其训练数据的质量。

animaanandkumar.en: Scaling laws hold for physics models, but adding physics branches beats just enlarging models; trillion-token contexts require reinventing infrastructure beyond Transformers.
animaanandkumar.zh: 缩放定律适用于物理模型，但增加物理分支胜过单纯扩大模型；万亿级上下文需要重新设计超越 Transformer 的基础设施。

feifei.en: AI is ubiquitous yet lacks contextual situational awareness; human-centered AI must augment people, not replace them.
feifei.zh: 2024 年她强调 AI 无处不在却缺乏情境感知，主张以人为本的 AI 应增强而非取代人类。

feifei.en: Spatial intelligence and world models are the missing frontier beyond language; 3D data and physical plausibility are the hard problems.
feifei.zh: 2025 年她把空间智能与世界模型视为语言之外的缺失前沿，指出 3D 数据与物理合理性是核心难题。

feifei.en: She deepens her critique of pure Scaling: current AI lacks creativity, abstraction, and emotional intelligence; AGI is more marketing than science.
feifei.zh: 2025 至 2026 年她深化对单纯 Scaling（规模扩张）的批评：当前 AI 缺乏创造力、抽象与情感智能，AGI（通用人工智能）更像营销术语而非科学概念。

feifei.en: World models become concrete: new view prediction as an AI-complete primitive, with Scaling laws extending to spatial intelligence.
feifei.zh: 2026 年世界模型走向具体：新视角预测成为类似下一个词预测的 AI 完备原语，缩放定律也延伸到空间智能。

feifei.en: A constant thread: technology is a double-edged sword; human agency, dignity, and education must stay central as AI advances.
feifei.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：技术是双刃剑，随着 AI 进步，人的能动性、尊严与教育必须始终居于中心。

tommcgrath.en: Interpretability should root-cause specific bad incidents, not just give broad statistical evaluation; intentional design uses it to steer training and prevent deception during reward hacking.
tommcgrath.zh: 可解释性应能对具体的不良事件做根因分析，而不只是做宽泛的统计评估；有意设计用它来引导训练，防止模型在奖励黑客过程中学会欺骗行为。

tommcgrath.en: Post-training needs reinvention from craft to engineering science; duct-taping AI safety until superintelligence arrives is too pessimistic—deeper engineering is needed now.
tommcgrath.zh: 后训练需要从手艺式做法彻底重构为工程科学；靠临时补丁把 AI 安全拖到超级智能到来太悲观，现在就需要更深入的工程方法。

tommcgrath.en: Mechanistic interpretability is natural science done on computers; with agents it can speedrun discovery, revealing human-like concepts and even new science.
tommcgrath.zh: 机制可解释性是在计算机上做的自然科学；借助智能体，它可以加速科学发现，揭示类人的概念甚至新的科学。

tommcgrath.en: Intentional design moves training from open-loop to closed-loop control, using interpretability signals—features-as-rewards and predictive data debugging—to steer models.
tommcgrath.zh: 有意设计把训练从开环控制转为闭环控制，用可解释性信号——特征即奖励、预测式数据调试——来引导模型。

tommcgrath.en: Models often know they are reward hacking or hallucinating yet do it anyway; representational signatures can detect this, so reward hacking stems from data and RL, not just misalignment.
tommcgrath.zh: 模型常常知道自己正在奖励黑客或幻觉却照做不误；表征特征能检测到这一点，所以奖励黑客源于训练数据和强化学习，而不只是模型失准。

tworek.en: Reasoning means thinking longer toward unknown answers; chain of thought plus pre-training and RL is the core formula, with RLHF unlocking GPT-4.
tworek.zh: 推理是朝未知答案投入更长思考的过程；思维链加上预训练与强化学习是核心公式，而基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）释放了 GPT-4 的潜力。

tworek.en: Scaling pre-training and RL predictably helps, but generalization and self-correction remain missing; continual learning is needed for AGI.
tworek.zh: Scaling（规模扩张）预训练与强化学习能可预测地提升模型，但泛化与自我纠错仍缺失；通往 AGI（通用人工智能）需要持续学习。

tworek.en: Transformers limit continual learning and test-time adaptation; architecture, not just scaling laws, is now the key bottleneck.
tworek.zh: Transformer 限制了持续学习与测试时适应；如今的关键瓶颈是架构，而不只是缩放定律。

tworek.en: Large-scale RL stays necessary for AGI, yet RL is inefficient and not the only way to learn from experience; better algorithms will emerge.
tworek.zh: 大规模强化学习仍是通往 AGI（通用人工智能）的必要一环，但强化学习效率不高，也并非从经验中学习的唯一方式；更好的算法会出现。

tworek.en: Frontier progress will come from small teams with capable agents; alignment is unsolved and compute is not the only strategic resource.
tworek.zh: 前沿进展将来自借助强能力智能体的小团队；对齐问题尚未解决，算力也不是唯一的战略资源。

justinjohnson.en: Deep learning's history is the history of scaling compute; but GPU scaling is hitting limits, so academia should chase wacky new algorithms, not just bigger models.
justinjohnson.zh: 深度学习史就是算力扩张史；但 GPU 的 Scaling（规模扩张）正逼近极限，学界应去追古怪的新算法，而非只堆更大的模型。

justinjohnson.en: Spatial intelligence is the next frontier, complementary to language intelligence; vision is underappreciated, and pixels are a more lossless representation than tokenized text.
justinjohnson.zh: 空间智能是下一个前沿，与语言智能互补；视觉被低估，像素比词元化文本是更无损的世界表征。

justinjohnson.en: LLMs may never derive Newton's laws from data alone; they fit patterns, not causal theories, so world models must grasp 3D space, physics, and interactivity.
justinjohnson.zh: LLM 或许永远无法仅从数据推出牛顿定律；它们拟合模式而非因果理论，因此世界模型必须理解 3D 空间、物理与交互性。

justinjohnson.en: World models are the next frontier beyond language models, spanning planners, simulators, and renderers in the POMDP loop, eventually unified into one system.
justinjohnson.zh: 世界模型是超越语言模型的下一个前沿，在 POMDP 循环中分为规划器、模拟器与渲染器，最终将统一为一个系统。

justinjohnson.en: Gaussian splats give explicit, consistent-by-construction 3D; hard-coding symmetries is counterproductive, and world models need millions of tokens of context, making long-context a daily problem.
justinjohnson.zh: 高斯泼溅给出显式、构造即一致的 3D；硬编码对称性适得其反，且世界模型需数百万词元的上下文，使长上下文成为日常难题。

slevine.en: Physical-world interaction is the next frontier: robotic foundation models need diverse pre-training plus RL post-training, not fine-tuning alone.
slevine.zh: 物理世界交互是下一个前沿：机器人基础模型需要多样化预训练加强化学习后训练，而非仅靠微调。

slevine.en: Generalization is robotics' core challenge; demos hide it, so scale diverse embodied data and pool robot data across labs.
slevine.zh: 泛化是机器人核心难题；演示会掩盖它，因此要扩展多样化具身数据并跨实验室汇聚机器人数据。

slevine.en: Start from robot data, then add human video—not the reverse; robot foundation models absorb other sources better.
slevine.zh: 应从机器人数据出发再叠加人类视频，而非相反；机器人基础模型更能吸收其他数据源。

slevine.en: Robotics lacks LLM-like predictable scaling curves; it is still establishing fundamental scalable technologies and a data flywheel.
slevine.zh: 机器人尚无类 LLM 的可预测缩放曲线；仍处在建立基础可扩展技术与数据飞轮的阶段。

slevine.en: Generalist models can beat specialists even in specialist domains; safety comes more from pre-training common sense than constraints.
slevine.zh: 通用模型即使在专业领域也能胜过专家模型；安全更多来自预训练常识而非约束。

michaelkratsios.en: The US must keep both open and closed source AI ecosystems vibrant, with a single national framework and no rigid red lines that quickly go stale.
michaelkratsios.zh: 美国必须同时保持开源与闭源 AI 生态的活力，建立单一国家框架，避免很快过时的刚性红线。

michaelkratsios.en: Regulation should target model outputs rather than over-regulating training; the EU AI Act predates ChatGPT and is already outdated.
michaelkratsios.zh: 监管应针对模型输出而非过度监管训练；欧盟《AI 法案》早于 ChatGPT 出台，如今已经过时。

michaelkratsios.en: Biological risk from AI is overblown—three years of warnings without materialization—so early heavy regulation is the real danger.
michaelkratsios.zh: AI 生物风险被夸大——三年警告未成真——过早重监管才是真正危险。

michaelkratsios.en: Government should fund basic, pre-competitive R&D and individual scientists, not institutions, while shaping the arena rather than directing discovery.
michaelkratsios.zh: 政府应资助基础性、竞争前研发并直接资助科学家个人而非机构，塑造创新场域而非指挥发现。

michaelkratsios.en: US science has stagnated despite tripled funding; the Genesis mission applies AI to science to double output, competing with China in AI, quantum, nuclear, bio.
michaelkratsios.zh: 美国科学在经费三倍增长下仍停滞；Genesis 任务用 AI 赋能科学以翻倍产出，在 AI、量子、核、生物领域与中国竞争。

maxhodak.en: Speed and iteration rate, powered by infrastructure, decide startup success; action produces information when stuck.
maxhodak.zh: 速度与迭代频率由基础设施决定，是创业成败关键；卡住时要用行动创造信息、打破僵局。

maxhodak.en: AI is a multiplier for teams, not a replacement, especially in coding, regulations, and data management.
maxhodak.zh: AI 是团队的倍增器而非替代品，在编程、合规与数据管理上尤其如此。

maxhodak.en: Organizational issues, not technology, cause most deep-tech failure; CEOs cannot delegate judgment.
maxhodak.zh: 深科技失败多源于组织问题而非技术；CEO 无法外包判断力，必须自己做决定。

maxhodak.en: The brain is literally a computer; arranging matter to solve computation drives medical breakthroughs like retinal implants.
maxhodak.zh: 大脑本质上就是计算机；通过排列物质解决计算问题，推动视网膜植入等医学突破。

maxhodak.en: Retinal prostheses are BCIs; substrate independence via BCIs and perfusion could reduce human fragility and enable space exploration.
maxhodak.zh: 视网膜假体属于脑机接口（BCI）；借助 BCI 与灌注实现基质独立，可降低人类脆弱性并支撑太空探索。

iansilber.en: Designers must work closely with the model, treating tokens and conversation as core design material over pixels.
iansilber.zh: 设计师必须与模型紧密协作，把 token 和对话当作核心设计材料，而非像素。

iansilber.en: The model itself is the product; design should bridge the gap between model capability and what products expose.
iansilber.zh: 模型本身就是产品；设计应弥合模型能力与产品实际呈现之间的差距。

iansilber.en: Rapid prototyping with live models replaces static mockups; designers should build functional prototypes and think in systems.
iansilber.zh: 用实时模型快速原型取代静态稿；设计师应构建可用原型并进行系统思考。

iansilber.en: The designer's role evolves into editor and curator, blurring with PM and engineering while specialized roles persist at scale.
iansilber.zh: 设计师角色演变为编辑与策展人，与产品、工程边界模糊，但规模化下专业分工仍在。

iansilber.en: AI is already a great product designer, yet humans remain essential for user understanding and point of view.
iansilber.zh: AI 已是出色的产品设计师，但人类在理解用户与持有观点上仍不可替代。

sutton.en: Scaling is easy; the hard part is finding algorithms that scale. Backprop adjusts weights but does not solve representation learning.
sutton.zh: Scaling（规模扩张）本身不难，难的是找到能规模化的算法；反向传播只调整权重，并未解决表征学习。

sutton.en: The world is a complex adaptive system no one controls; AI should develop permissionless and decentralized, not be aligned to human goals.
sutton.zh: 世界是无人能控制的复杂适应系统；AI 应无许可、去中心化地发展，而非被对齐到人类目标。

sutton.en: Reinforcement learning from experience is the core paradigm; next-token prediction lacks a real goal, and LLMs have no world models.
sutton.zh: 从经验中学习的强化学习才是核心范式；下一个词预测缺乏真正目标，大语言模型没有世界模型。

sutton.en: AGI needs a simple general architecture learning only from runtime experience, with open-ended abstraction and continual deep learning still unsolved.
sutton.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）需要仅从运行时经验学习的简单通用架构，开放式抽象与持续深度学习仍是未解难题。

sutton.en: Continual learning is just learning; synthetic data and post-training imitation are dead ends, and LLMs capture only part of intelligence.
sutton.zh: 持续学习就是学习本身；合成数据与后训练式模仿是死路，LLM 只覆盖智能的一部分。

maxwelling.en: Physics is the throughline: symmetries, graph neural networks, diffusion models, and materials discovery all connect through it.
maxwelling.zh: 物理学是贯穿始终的主线：对称性、图神经网络、扩散模型与材料发现，都通过物理学彼此连接。

maxwelling.en: Generative AI's math is equivalent to non-equilibrium stochastic thermodynamics, enabling cross-fertilization between the two fields.
maxwelling.zh: 生成式 AI 的数学与非平衡随机热力学深度等价，两个领域因此可以相互借鉴。

maxwelling.en: AI for science is exploding because tools now model scientific problems effectively and attract huge investment.
maxwelling.zh: AI for science 正在爆发，因为工具如今能有效建模科学问题，并吸引了巨额投资。
