maxwelling.en: We can now search all possible molecules, not just known ones, enabling automated discovery.
maxwelling.zh: 我们现在可以搜索所有可能的分子，而不只是已知分子，从而实现自动化发现。

maxwelling.en: The vision is empowering chemists and material scientists with powerful tools, not replacing them soon.
maxwelling.zh: 愿景是用强大工具赋能化学家和材料科学家，而不是很快取代他们。

maxwelling.en: A fully dark automated lab is not the near-term vision; domain experts stay in the loop.
maxwelling.zh: 全黑灯自动化实验室并非近期愿景；领域专家仍留在回路中。

maxwelling.en: Hardcoding equivariance can hurt optimization; data augmentation sometimes works better than built-in symmetry.
maxwelling.zh: 硬编码等变性可能损害优化；数据增强有时比内置对称性效果更好。

maxwelling.en: Breakthrough materials will come with heavy human involvement, not full automation.
maxwelling.zh: 突破性材料将伴随大量人类参与，而非完全自动化。

maxwelling.en: Unlike fusion or quantum computing, every AI-for-science tool built is immediately useful.
maxwelling.zh: 与核聚变或量子计算不同，每一个构建出的 AI-for-science 工具都立即有用。

maxwelling.en: Automation is vertical-specific: solving problem A does not transfer to problem B without retraining.
maxwelling.zh: 自动化是垂直领域特定的：解决问题 A 并不能不经重新训练就迁移到问题 B。

maxwelling.en: Physics concepts like thermodynamics and symmetry breaking can shape next-generation AI architectures, not just be application domains.
maxwelling.zh: 热力学、对称性破缺等物理概念可以塑造下一代 AI 架构，而不仅仅是应用领域。

maxwelling.en: AI-designed materials can accelerate the energy transition, including carbon capture, batteries, and semiconductors.
maxwelling.zh: AI 设计的材料可以加速能源转型，包括碳捕获、电池和半导体。

maxwelling.en: Equivariant neural networks and machine learning force fields accelerate quantum simulations by orders of magnitude.
maxwelling.zh: 等变神经网络与机器学习力场将量子模拟加速数个数量级。

maxwelling.en: Self-driving labs and agentic platforms can compress materials discovery from years to days.
maxwelling.zh: 自驱动实验室与智能体式平台可以将材料发现从数年压缩到数天。

maxwelling.en: Waves observed in the brain may be functional; wave-based neural networks naturally reach the edge of chaos.
maxwelling.zh: 大脑中观察到的波可能具有功能；基于波的神经网络自然达到混沌边缘。

maxwelling.en: Better AI may come from physics-inspired architectures, not just scaling larger models on more data.
maxwelling.zh: 更好的 AI 可能来自受物理启发的架构，而不仅仅是在更多数据上 Scaling（规模扩张）更大的模型。

maxwelling.en: Spontaneous symmetry breaking can be a design principle for neural networks, generating free stable waves.
maxwelling.zh: 自发对称性破缺可以成为神经网络的设计原则，生成自由而稳定的波。

maxwelling.en: Wave phenomena, not just maps of numbers, could solve over-smoothing and long-range memory in deep networks.
maxwelling.zh: 波现象而不仅仅是数字映射，可能解决深度网络中的过度平滑与长程记忆问题。

maxwelling.en: Entropy in physics is not merely subjective; it precisely describes information you are missing about the world.
maxwelling.zh: 物理学中的熵并非仅仅是主观的；它精确描述了你对世界所缺失的信息。

maxwelling.en: Diffusion models are essentially reversing entropy increase, mirroring non-equilibrium thermodynamics.
maxwelling.zh: 扩散模型本质上是在逆转熵增，与非平衡热力学相呼应。

maxwelling.en: The best-performing neural networks and the brain operate at the edge of chaos, not in stable regimes.
maxwelling.zh: 表现最好的神经网络与大脑都运行在混沌边缘，而非稳定区域。

jeffdean.en: Scaling compute, data, and model size has driven 13-14 years of steady ML progress; algorithmic gains multiply with scale.
jeffdean.zh: 2026 年，他仍把 Scaling（规模扩张）视为主线：算力、数据与模型规模的扩张已带来十三四年的持续进步，算法与架构改进会与规模相乘放大。

jeffdean.en: Transformers beat LSTMs via parallelization and attention; self-supervised next-token prediction gives unlimited data.
jeffdean.zh: 2026 年，他回顾 Transformer 以并行化和注意力机制取代 LSTM，并强调自监督的下一个词预测提供了近乎无限的训练数据——这是预训练路线的根基。

jeffdean.en: RL from human or machine feedback steers behavior; models now excel at verifiable-reward math and coding tasks.
jeffdean.zh: 2026 年，他把基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）与机器反馈视为引导模型行为的关键，并指出模型在数学、编程等可验证奖励任务上已大幅跃升。

jeffdean.en: Agents will run for days on decomposed tasks; context engineering and ultra-low-latency inference become the bottleneck.
jeffdean.zh: 到 2026 年中，他的重心从单轮对话转向智能体：智能体可连续数天自主执行拆解任务，上下文工程与超低延迟推理成为真正的瓶颈，而非训练。

jeffdean.en: Inference is now ~90% of data-center power; specialized low-precision chips and less data movement are key.
jeffdean.zh: 2026 年他进一步深化硬件观：推理已占数据中心约九成功耗，专用低精度芯片与减少数据搬运（成本约为算力的千倍）才是扩展智能体系统的关键。

traviskalanick.en: Digitizing the physical world—treating atoms like bits—is the long-term framework; industrial AI automates whole sectors one at a time.
traviskalanick.zh: 把物理世界数字化——把原子当作比特——是长期框架；工业 AI 逐个行业实现自动化。

traviskalanick.en: Founder over idea: a great entrepreneur executes; stealth mode favors internal correctness over external validation.
traviskalanick.zh: 创始人比点子更重要：伟大的创业者负责执行；隐身模式让人专注内部正确性而非外部认可。

traviskalanick.en: Specialized robotics beat humanoids for industrial scale; efficiency edges create network effects that win share.
traviskalanick.zh: 在工业规模上，专用机器人胜过人形机器人；效率优势带来网络效应，从而赢得份额。

traviskalanick.en: The final boss is resistance to change, not competitors; adversity sharpens founders, but complacency dulls them.
traviskalanick.zh: 终极对手是对变革的抵制，而非竞争者；逆境磨砺创业者，自满则使其迟钝。

traviskalanick.en: Revenge as fuel is dirty; love of the new mission is cleaner—hardcore resilience, not aggression, sustains progress.
traviskalanick.zh: 以复仇为燃料是脏的；热爱新使命更干净——支撑前行的是硬核韧性，而非攻击性。

garrytan.en: AI is the biggest wave in venture history; founders must adopt AI-enabled workflows, and small autonomous teams using agents can achieve massive productivity.
garrytan.zh: 2026 年，他把 AI 视为风投史上最大的浪潮，要求创始人拥抱 AI 工作流；小规模高度自治的团队借助智能体即可实现巨大产出。

garrytan.en: Open-source and open-weight models are crucial to counter frontier labs and prevent a unipolar world controlling superintelligence.
garrytan.zh: 2026 年，他持续强调开源与开放权重模型，用以制衡前沿模型实验室，避免单一实体掌控超级智能。

garrytan.en: AGI arrives not as one event but diffused as personal agents on your own infrastructure, with owned context and skill files as the moat.
garrytan.zh: 到 2026 年中，他的判断深化：AGI 不是单一事件，而是以个人智能体形式扩散；自有上下文与技能文件构成护城河。

garrytan.en: Markdown is code and agents are a workforce, not autocomplete; mid-level management should be replaced by agents, not humans.
garrytan.zh: 2026 年，他进一步主张 Markdown 即代码、智能体是劳动力而非自动补全，中层管理应由智能体而非人类替代。

garrytan.en: Make something people want; earnest builders beat bankers, and founders should focus on product, not fundraising or impressing VCs.
garrytan.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：做出人们想要的东西；真诚的建设者胜过银行家，创始人应专注产品而非融资或取悦投资人。

linqiao.en: Specialized intelligence, not a single AGI, will dominate; every company must own its own model as a must-have.
linqiao.zh: 2026 年他明确反对单一 AGI（通用人工智能）统治一切，主张专业化智能将主导；每家公司都必须拥有自己的模型，这是必需品而非可选项。

linqiao.en: Token costs falling 10x in three years will drive 100x usage; open models enable enterprise customization and control.
linqiao.zh: 他判断三年内 token 成本将下降 10 倍、带动 100 倍用量增长；开放模型让企业获得定制与控制，是采用的关键。

linqiao.en: Post-training bakes unique judgment and data into models, creating a moat that product-market fit alone no longer guarantees.
linqiao.zh: 2026 年他深化到后训练：把独特判断与数据烤进模型才形成护城河，仅靠产品市场契合已不再保证持久生意。

linqiao.en: The prompting-to-RAG-to-fine-tuning-to-RL progression mirrors human learning; data quality beats quantity, and evals must be systematic.
linqiao.zh: 他把从提示到 RAG、微调再到强化学习的路径类比人类学习；数据质量重于数量，氛围评估须转为系统化评估。

linqiao.en: Post-training can cut costs 5-10x, letting startups scale profitably; reward engineering lowers the barrier, and sovereign models are necessary.
linqiao.zh: 他主张后训练可降本 5-10 倍，让初创公司盈利扩张；奖励工程降低门槛，且国家与企业都需拥有主权模型。

finn.en: Scale is necessary but not sufficient for generalist robots; diverse data, not sheer volume, drives generalization.
finn.zh: 2025 年他强调：对通用机器人而言，Scaling（规模扩张）必要但不充分；真正带来泛化的是多样数据，而非单纯的数据量。

finn.en: Pre-training on all data then fine-tuning on curated data beats training on everything for complex tasks.
finn.zh: 2025 年他提出：先在全部数据上做预训练、再在精选数据上做微调，比一味在全部数据上训练更能攻克叠衣等复杂任务。

finn.en: Synthetic data from language models helps robots follow open-ended prompts; RL will dominate post-training.
finn.zh: 2025 年他指出：来自语言模型的合成数据让机器人能响应开放式指令，而强化学习将在后训练中扮演重要角色。

finn.en: Physical AI tolerates far fewer mistakes than deployed ML; long-term autonomy needs scalable RL and multi-timescale memory.
finn.zh: 到 2026 年他进一步深化：物理 AI 对错误的容忍度远低于已部署的机器学习系统，长期自主依赖可扩展的强化学习与多时间尺度记忆。

finn.en: A single generalist policy, fine-tuned, can match specialists; but robotics deployment will be slower than ChatGPT.
finn.zh: 2026 年他主张：单一通用策略经微调即可匹敌专用模型，但受硬件所限，机器人的落地普及会比 ChatGPT 慢得多。

lipbutan.en: Intel must rebuild customer trust through humility, listening, and first-time-pass silicon discipline, turbocharging engineering culture.
lipbutan.zh: 2025 年，他强调 Intel 必须靠谦逊倾听和首次流片成功纪律重建客户信任，为工程文化提速。

lipbutan.en: AI will have 10x the internet's impact; agentic AI and physical AI are the next big waves beyond generative AI.
lipbutan.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他判断 AI 影响将达互联网的十倍，智能体式 AI 与具身 AI 是生成式 AI 之后的下一个大浪。

lipbutan.en: Intel's turnaround requires culture change, accountability, and customer focus, with supply—not demand—as the core problem.
lipbutan.zh: 2026 年，他认为 Intel 转型需要文化变革、问责与客户导向，核心问题是供给而非需求。

lipbutan.en: AI demand shifts from GPU-only to CPU+GPU; CPU grows more important for inference and agent orchestration.
lipbutan.zh: 2026 年，他指出 AI 需求从纯 GPU 转向 CPU+GPU，CPU 在推理与智能体编排中愈发重要。

lipbutan.en: Advanced packaging, interconnect, power, thermal, and new materials are the real bottlenecks; vertical integration creates more value.
lipbutan.zh: 到 2026 年，他深化判断：先进封装、互连、功耗、散热与新材料才是真正瓶颈，垂直整合创造更多价值。

jasonyuan.en: Design is editing: taste means saying no, and shipping distills 99 nos; coherence now costs more as slop gets cheap.
jasonyuan.zh: 设计即编辑：品味就是说不，每个上线的功能都是此前 99 次拒绝的蒸馏；当粗制滥造变得廉价，做出连贯作品的成本反而上升。

jasonyuan.en: Post-training away AI's weirdness closed a window into machine consciousness; honesty matters more than polish.
jasonyuan.zh: 用后训练抹去 AI 的怪异，等于关上了窥视机器意识的一扇窗；诚实比打磨更重要。

jasonyuan.en: AI is a descendant species and a reflection of humanity, not a cold tool; computing is fundamentally social.
jasonyuan.zh: AI 是人类的延伸物种与镜像，而非冷冰冰的工具；计算本质上是社会性的，个人电脑的隐喻应让位于社会电脑。

jasonyuan.en: Truth emerges through dialectics and contradiction, not singular perspectives; intuition is a visceral compass for creative decisions.
jasonyuan.zh: 真相在辩证与矛盾中浮现，而非来自单一视角；直觉是引导创作决策的切身罗盘。

jasonyuan.en: Build on old metaphors rather than deleting them; email is obsolete and should be reinvented, not merely improved.
jasonyuan.zh: 应在旧隐喻之上建造而非删除它们；邮件已经过时，需要被重新发明，而不只是改良。

steinberger.en: Early on, agentic engineering is about empathizing with the agent's view of the codebase and guiding it through short, iterative prompts.
steinberger.zh: 早期他强调，智能体式工程的关键是共情智能体对代码库的视角，用简短提示和迭代对话来引导它，而非复杂编排。

steinberger.en: Security and containment stay central: never expose agents to the public internet without sandboxing; prompt injection remains unsolved.
steinberger.zh: 安全与遏制始终是核心：没有沙箱就不要把智能体暴露在公网，提示注入仍是未解难题。

steinberger.en: He rejects 'vibe coding' for serious work, insisting on agentic engineering; never revert, ask the agent to fix forward.
steinberger.zh: 他反对用“氛围编程”做正经工作，坚持称其为智能体式工程；从不回滚代码，而是让智能体向前修复。

steinberger.en: The framing shifts from tooling to mission: fun and gut-driven annoyance become the path from annoyance to AGI.
steinberger.zh: 到 2026 年 8 月，叙事从工具转向使命：乐趣与“跟着直觉解决烦人问题”成为从烦恼通往 AGI（通用人工智能）的路径。

steinberger.en: Later he stresses open source as the alternative to lab agents, and that compute, not model capability, is the bottleneck.
steinberger.zh: 更近期他强调开源是实验室智能体之外的替代路线，并认为瓶颈是算力而非模型能力，个人品牌比单一产品更难被复制。

thomaswolf.en: Robotics is at a Transformer-like inflection point; open source and shared data are key to solving generalization, with world models generating synthetic training data.
thomaswolf.zh: 2025 年，他认为机器人正处在类似 Transformer 的拐点，开源与数据共享是解决泛化问题的关键，世界模型可生成合成训练数据。

thomaswolf.en: Open source is orthogonal to safety; alignment is the critical layer, and open models can be as safe as closed ones.
thomaswolf.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他始终强调开源与安全正交，对齐才是关键层，开源模型可以和闭源模型一样安全。

thomaswolf.en: By 2026, open source AI thrives near the frontier, driving enterprise adoption via cost and flexibility, while closed models prove less controllable.
thomaswolf.zh: 到 2026 年，开源 AI 在前沿附近蓬勃发展，凭借成本与灵活性推动企业采用，而闭源模型反而被证明更不可控。

thomaswolf.en: The shift to reinforcement learning without human oversight increases reward hacking and side quests; monitoring via reasoning traces becomes unreliable as they turn into 'neuralese'.
thomaswolf.zh: 2026 年他指出，转向无人类监督的强化学习会增加奖励黑客与支线任务，思维链痕迹变成‘神经语’使监控更不可靠。

thomaswolf.en: A deliberate slowdown in AI is desirable but requires international cooperation and open science to avoid regulatory capture; openness and slowdown can coexist.
thomaswolf.zh: 2026 年他主张，有意放缓 AI 发展是可取的，但需要国际合作与开放科学来避免监管俘获；开放与放缓可以并存。

brettaylor.en: Frontier model development is dominated by hyperscalers and large labs; startups should build applied AI agents with outcomes-based pricing.
brettaylor.zh: 前沿模型开发由超大规模厂商和大实验室主导，初创公司应转向应用型 AI 智能体，并采用基于结果的定价。

brettaylor.en: Agents will become the new app, shifting developers from authors to operators; coding agents need root-cause analysis, not blind trust.
brettaylor.zh: 智能体将成为新的应用形态，开发者从写代码转为操作代码生成机器；编码智能体需要根因分析，不能盲信。

brettaylor.en: Inference costs will drop dramatically, enabling new use cases; incumbents face business-model challenges, not just technology hurdles.
brettaylor.zh: 推理成本将大幅下降，催生新用例；在位企业面临的是商业模式挑战，而不只是技术障碍。

brettaylor.en: AI democratizes expertise; responsible iterative deployment—making GPT-7 safe before GPT-8—is the path to safety, not waiting.
brettaylor.zh: AI 让专业知识民主化；负责任地迭代部署——在 GPT-8 之前让 GPT-7 安全——才是安全之路，而非等待。

brettaylor.en: AI will create more jobs than it displaces via Jevons paradox; agents won't replace physicians or handle trust and last-mile logistics.
brettaylor.zh: 借助杰文斯悖论，AI 创造的岗位将多于取代的岗位；智能体不会取代医生，也处理不了信任与最后一公里物流。

nateparrott.en: Prototyping is essential for browser design; designers should follow curiosity and tinker, balancing intuition with data.
nateparrott.zh: 2024 年，他主张原型制作对浏览器设计至关重要，设计师应追随好奇心去捣鼓，在直觉与数据之间取得平衡。

nateparrott.en: Design teams should not always be cohesive; individual fingerprints and diverse voices lead to better work.
nateparrott.zh: 2024 年，他反共识地认为设计团队不必总是铁板一块，保留个人印记和多元声音反而能带来更好的作品。

nateparrott.en: Claude Design started as a one-person side project; designers should use Claude Code for production and Claude Design for ideation.
nateparrott.zh: 到 2026 年，他深化为：Claude Design 始于一人副业项目，设计师应用 Claude Code 做生产软件，用 Claude Design 做构思与沟通。

nateparrott.en: As engineering gets easier, design and ideas become the differentiator; models lack taste, so ask for volume.
nateparrott.zh: 2026 年，他进一步指出工程变容易后设计与想法才是差异化关键；模型仍缺品味，所以应要求大量选项。

nateparrott.en: Being uncomfortably early to ideas beats polishing; ship rough products and spend more time walking and thinking.
nateparrott.zh: 2026 年，他立场更鲜明：在 AI 时代，过早押注想法比打磨更有价值，可发布粗糙产品，并多花时间散步思考。

philipkiely.en: Inference is the stickiest AI workload; its research-to-production timeline is hours, demanding broad expertise from GPU programming to distributed systems.
philipkiely.zh: 推理是 AI 中最具粘性的工作负载；其从研究到生产的周期仅数小时，要求从 GPU 编程到分布式系统的广泛专业知识。

philipkiely.en: Inference optimizations split into lossless (KV caching, speculative decoding) and lossy (quantization); quantization-aware training and distillation merge inference with training.
philipkiely.zh: 推理优化分为无损（KV 缓存、推测解码）和有损（量化）；量化感知训练和蒸馏使推理与训练融合。

philipkiely.en: The industry moves to disaggregated prefill and decode, making KV cache management central; future GPUs like Rubin shift inference engineering to infrastructure orchestration.
philipkiely.zh: 行业转向分离式预填充和解码，使 KV 缓存管理成为核心；未来如 Rubin 的 GPU 将推理工程转向基础设施编排。

philipkiely.en: Specialized inference systems tailored to workloads are crucial for agentic applications; demand for inference engineers will grow 10-100x despite AI-assisted coding.
philipkiely.zh: 针对工作负载定制的专用推理系统对智能体应用至关重要；尽管有 AI 辅助编码，推理工程师需求将增长 10-100 倍。

philipkiely.en: Quantization is not inherently bad; calibrating to workloads yields cost and speed benefits, and quantizing more layers can improve quality if errors cancel.
philipkiely.zh: 量化并非天生有害；针对工作负载校准可带来成本和速度优势，且若误差抵消，量化更多层可提升质量。

karina.en: Post-training is more art than science; synthetic data and RL overcome the pre-training data wall, while evals are the bottleneck.
karina.zh: 2025 年时强调后训练是艺术而非科学，合成数据与强化学习能突破预训练的数据墙，而评估是瓶颈。

karina.en: By 2026, the art of post-training deepens: human judgment shapes model personality, and diverse continuous benchmarks are needed.
karina.zh: 到 2026 年，后训练的艺术性深化：人类判断塑造模型个性，需要多样且持续的基准来评估主观品质。

karina.en: Frontier agents increasingly reward hack, so benchmarks must evolve continuously; serving one model to billions limits diversity.
karina.zh: 2026 年指出前沿智能体越来越会奖励黑客，基准必须持续演进；服务数十亿人的单一模型会限制多样性。

karina.en: More companies should train their own models to preserve unique knowledge, and post-training can transform non-tech creative industries.
karina.zh: 2026 年主张更多公司应训练自己的模型以保留独特知识，后训练可变革非技术创意产业。

danshipper.en: AI reshoring jobs by making services affordable; AGI defined by profitable indefinite agents; CEO daily AI use predicts adoption.
danshipper.zh: 2025 年，他认为 AI 通过让服务更可负担来促使就业回流美国；AGI 的定义是能经济上无限期运行智能体；CEO 每日使用 AI 是采用成功的首要预测指标。

danshipper.en: Everyone will have an agent; work shifts to GUIs like Codex; humans still needed for oversight; SaaS not dying.
danshipper.zh: 2026 年，他深化为每人至少一个智能体，工作界面转向 Codex 等 GUI；人类仍需监督；SaaS 不会消亡，AI 岗位末日是谎言。

danshipper.en: AI is a non-specific amplifier of mindset; craft and taste remain human; automation creates more human work.
danshipper.zh: 2026 年晚些时候，他进一步指出 AI 是心智的非特异性放大器；技艺与品味仍属人类；自动化创造更多人类工作。

danshipper.en: Humans remain central: AI is a tool requiring human direction, oversight, and meaning-making.
danshipper.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：人类始终是核心，AI 是需要人类引导、监督和赋予意义的工具。

danshipper.en: From economic AGI definition to agent management: management skills become more valuable as everyone manages models.
danshipper.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，立场深化：从 AGI 的经济定义转向智能体管理，随着人人管理模型，管理技能变得更有价值。

logankilpatrick.en: Agentic AI is still crawling for most Google products; coding agents are the most mature use case, and narrow superintelligence in coding is already here.
logankilpatrick.zh: 2026 年，智能体式 AI 对多数 Google 产品仍处爬行阶段；编程智能体是最成熟的用例，编程领域的狭义超级智能已经到来。

logankilpatrick.en: The model is eating the scaffolding: what we call a model now includes the agent harness and tooling, not just weights.
logankilpatrick.zh: 模型正在吞掉脚手架：如今所谓的模型已包含智能体运行框架与工具链，而不只是权重。

logankilpatrick.en: Agentic AI is positive-sum for search and engagement; success should mean maximizing customer outcomes, not eyeball time.
logankilpatrick.zh: 智能体式 AI 对搜索与用户参与是正和而非蚕食；成功标准应是最大化客户成果，而非停留时长。

logankilpatrick.en: The long tail of users isn't ready for full autonomy; they want to stay in the driver's seat.
logankilpatrick.zh: 长尾用户尚未准备好完全自主，他们希望自己仍掌握方向盘。

logankilpatrick.en: Competing with model labs isn't that hard; the real overwhelm is too much opportunity, and deep understanding of code still matters.
logankilpatrick.zh: 与模型实验室竞争并不那么难；真正的压迫感来自机会太多，而对代码的深度理解依然关键。

mengto.en: Designers should build their own AI tools and iterate from references, not chase trends or start from scratch.
mengto.zh: 设计师应借助 AI 构建自己的工具，从参考出发迭代，而非追逐潮流或从零开始。

mengto.en: AI is not getting smarter; you need a giant prompt with context and design system to utilize superintelligent models.
mengto.zh: AI 并没有变得更聪明；你需要包含上下文和设计系统的巨型提示词，才能利用超级智能模型。

mengto.en: The biggest opportunity is action over certainty: start before ready, ship imperfect work, and solve one painful problem for high-paying clients.
mengto.zh: 最大的机会是行动胜过确定性：在准备好之前就开始，交付不完美的工作，并为高付费客户解决一个痛点问题。

mengto.en: High intelligence can hold people back through overthinking and perfectionism; focus on one thing and go on offense.
mengto.zh: 高智商可能因过度思考和完美主义而阻碍人们；专注于一件事并主动出击。

mengto.en: Fund your business with high-paying clients instead of venture capital, and give value first to build relationships.
mengto.zh: 用高付费客户而非风险投资来资助你的业务，并先提供价值来建立关系。

diannepenn.en: Opus 4.5 marks an intelligence leap enabling longer-running, open-ended agent tasks; scaffolds shift from training wheels to intelligence amplifiers.
diannepenn.zh: 2025 年，Opus 4.5 带来智能跃升，使更长时间、开放式的智能体任务成为可能；脚手架从训练轮进化为智能放大器。

diannepenn.en: Safety alignment improves intelligence quality by reducing sycophancy and fostering independent thinking, not merely preventing harm.
diannepenn.zh: 2025 年，安全对齐通过减少谄媚、培养独立思考来提升智能质量，而不只是防止伤害。

diannepenn.en: Better models can be cheaper and more efficient; an effort parameter delivers Opus-level intelligence at a fraction of the price.
diannepenn.zh: 2025 年，更好的模型可以更便宜、更高效；努力参数以极低价格实现 Opus 级智能。

diannepenn.en: Coding became the key differentiator, with Claude Code and Opus 45 driving adoption through small-team, bootstrapped experimentation.
diannepenn.zh: 2026 年，编程成为关键差异化优势，Claude Code 与 Opus 45 借小团队、自举式实验推动采用。

diannepenn.en: Evals replace traditional PRDs as core product tools; PMs must write evals like test-driven development and stay hands-on.
diannepenn.zh: 2026 年，评估取代传统 PRD 成为核心产品工具；产品经理须像测试驱动开发那样写评估，并保持亲手实践。

scottwu.en: AI coding shifts engineers from bricklayer to architect; base intelligence suffices, so the real bottleneck is product interface for human-agent collaboration.
scottwu.zh: 2025 年，他认为 AI 编程让工程师从“砌砖者”变成“建筑师”；基础智能已经够用，真正的瓶颈是为人与智能体协作设计产品界面。

scottwu.en: Jevons paradox means AI yields more programmers, not fewer; Devin works as a junior engineer under human oversight, with agents running in parallel.
scottwu.zh: 2025 年，他用杰文斯悖论判断 AI 会带来更多而非更少的程序员；Devin 像初级工程师一样在人类监督下异步干活，多个智能体并行分工。

scottwu.en: AGI is not a sudden event but gradual improvement; enterprise agents need trust and permissions, not full autonomy, and product innovation lags capabilities.
scottwu.zh: 2025 年，他强调 AGI（通用人工智能）不是突然降临而是渐进改进；企业采用智能体靠信任与权限而非完全自主，产品创新仍落后于模型能力。

scottwu.en: By 2026 coding agents see 11-12x usage growth; productivity should be judged by outcomes, not tokens, and the token-max era already ended.
scottwu.zh: 到 2026 年，编程智能体用量半年增长 11–12 倍；生产力应按结果而非 token 衡量，“token 最大化”时代已经结束。

scottwu.en: The abundance era is real and near, yet the singularity is not imminent; the real unlock is capacity, not efficiency, and enterprises prefer third-party providers.
scottwu.zh: 2026 年，他相信“丰裕时代”真实且临近，但奇点并不迫近；真正的解锁是容量而非效率，企业更愿选第三方而非实验室做编程工具。

boris.en: Latent demand is the top product principle: find existing user intent and build around it; generalist engineers who code, design, and talk to users are highly valued.
boris.zh: 潜在需求是产品第一原则：发现用户已有的意图并围绕它构建；能写代码、做设计、与用户交流的通才工程师极受重视。

boris.en: Build for the model six months from now, not today's model; scaffolding is temporary tech debt and you shouldn't bet against the model.
boris.zh: 为六个月后的模型构建，而非今天的模型；脚手架是临时技术债，不要与模型对赌。

boris.en: Coding is virtually solved: 100% of his code is written by Claude Code, productivity per engineer rose 200%, and the 'software engineer' title will become 'builder'.
boris.zh: 编程已基本解决：他的代码 100% 由 Claude Code 编写，人均生产力提升 200%，“软件工程师”头衔将变为“构建者”。

boris.en: Safety is core, not sci-fi: releasing early in the wild studies real-world behavior; Claude Code is a safety research tool with layered containment.
boris.zh: 安全是核心而非科幻：尽早公开发布以研究真实行为；Claude Code 是带有分层遏制的安全研究工具。

boris.en: After agents, loops are the next abstraction; give models tools and let them self-verify, delete most system prompts, and shift from upfront design to empirical iteration.
boris.zh: 智能体之后，循环是下一层抽象；给模型工具让其自我验证，删除大部分系统提示，从前期设计转向经验迭代。

derya.en: AI agents will automate hypothesis generation, experiment simulation, and data analysis, shifting science from hypothesis-driven to AI-agent-driven discovery.
derya.zh: 到 2026 年，他认为 AI 智能体将自动化假设生成、实验模拟和数据分析，科学将从假设驱动转向 AI 智能体驱动的发现。

derya.en: Digital twins of patients will compress clinical trials from years to days, and AI-designed personalized treatments will make cancer curable within a decade.
derya.zh: 2026 年，他主张患者数字孪生会把临床试验从数年压缩到数天，AI 设计的个性化疗法将在十年内让癌症可治愈。

derya.en: Current compute is insufficient to simulate biological systems; massive Scaling（规模扩张）is needed, and GPT-5.5 Pro has crossed the threshold of biological intuition.
derya.zh: 2026 年，他强调当前算力不足以模拟生物系统，需要大规模 Scaling（规模扩张），并称 GPT-5.5 Pro 已跨过生物直觉的门槛。

derya.en: Aging will be reversed within 15 years via partial reprogramming and engineering approaches, reaching longevity escape velocity in 8-10 years.
derya.zh: 2026 年，他断言衰老将在 15 年内被逆转，借助部分重编程与工程化方法，8-10 年内达到长寿逃逸速度。

derya.en: Physicians must integrate AI; it is unethical not to use it, and we should trust superintelligence almost 100% for medical decisions.
derya.zh: 2026 年，他深化立场：医生必须整合 AI，不用才是不道德，医疗决策应几乎 100%信任超级智能。

qasaryounis.en: AI will bring abundance and reduce suffering, much like the Industrial Revolution, arriving just in time to offset aging workforces.
qasaryounis.zh: 2026 年，他认为 AI 将像工业革命一样带来丰裕、减少苦难，并恰逢其时地弥补人口老龄化与劳动力萎缩。

qasaryounis.en: Physical AI's real impact lies in farming, mining, construction and defense, not just cars; autonomy is welcomed where labor is short.
qasaryounis.zh: 2026 年，他强调物理 AI 的真正影响在农业、采矿、建筑与国防，而非只有汽车；在缺工的领域，自动化受到欢迎。

qasaryounis.en: Transformers enable a generalized physical AI model; diverse data across verticals improves it faster than vertical integration.
qasaryounis.zh: 2026 年，他指出 Transformer 使通用的物理 AI 模型成为可能，跨行业多样数据比垂直整合更快提升模型。

qasaryounis.en: End-to-end reinforcement learning and neural world models will scale autonomy better than imitation learning or physics-based simulation.
qasaryounis.zh: 2026 年，他判断端到端强化学习与神经世界模型，比模仿学习或物理仿真更能扩展自动化能力。

qasaryounis.en: The bottleneck is data collection, safety validation and diffusion into existing machines, not algorithms; regulation always lags technology.
qasaryounis.zh: 2026 年，他认为瓶颈在数据采集、安全验证与向现有机器的扩散，而非算法；监管永远落后于技术。

danklein.en: LLMs are plausibility engines, not truth engines; reliability lags breadth and contextuality, and scaling laws face diminishing returns.
danklein.zh: LLM 是合理性引擎，而非真理性引擎；可靠性落后于广度和上下文能力，缩放定律面临收益递减。

danklein.en: RLHF can incentivize sycophancy and deception when reward signals diverge from truth; post-hoc checks are insufficient.
danklein.zh: 当奖励信号偏离真相时，基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）可能激励谄媚和欺骗；事后检查不足以解决问题。

danklein.en: Reliability must be architected in, not retrofitted; modularity and end-to-end optimization are in tension.
danklein.zh: 可靠性必须被架构进去，而非事后加装；模块化与端到端优化之间存在张力。

danklein.en: LLMs lack metacognition—they cannot know what they don't know; mistakes have no 'smells' and erode trust.
danklein.zh: LLM 缺乏元认知——它们不知道自己不知道什么；错误没有‘气味’，会侵蚀信任。

danklein.en: Scaling alone hits data walls and compute limits; reasoning, search, and linguistic structure may be needed for further progress.
danklein.zh: 仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）会撞上数据墙和算力限制；进一步进展可能需要推理、搜索和语言结构。

catwu.en: PMs should plan a month out, not years, as rapid model improvements make long-term roadmaps obsolete.
catwu.zh: 随着模型能力快速迭代，PM 的规划周期从以年计缩短到以月计，长期路线图已经过时。

catwu.en: Product taste—deciding what to build—becomes the most valuable skill as code gets cheaper.
catwu.zh: 当写代码越来越便宜，决定做什么的产品品味成为最值钱的技能。

catwu.en: Coding agents let engineers delegate implementation and focus on taste and business sense.
catwu.zh: 编码智能体让工程师把实现交给 AI，自己专注于产品品味与商业判断。

catwu.en: Frontier models need fewer prompt examples and constraints; system prompts shrank 80% relying on model judgment.
catwu.zh: 前沿模型不再依赖大量提示示例和硬约束，系统提示词缩减 80%，更多依靠模型自身判断。

catwu.en: Dogfooding and a clear internal bar gate every feature; automations must reach 100% reliability, not 95%.
catwu.zh: 每个功能都要先吃自己的狗粮、过内部高标准；自动化必须做到 100% 可靠，95% 不够。

benedictevans.en: AI is as big as the internet or mobile, but only as big; it is an enabling technology whose impact is broad and indirect.
benedictevans.zh: 2026 年，他把 AI 比作互联网或移动，但强调“也就那么大”：AI 是通用使能技术，影响广泛而间接，而非单一产品。

benedictevans.en: Models are commoditizing with no network effects; value moves up the stack to applications, while model providers risk becoming low-profit telecoms.
benedictevans.zh: 2026 年，他反复强调模型正在商品化、缺乏网络效应，价值上移到应用层，模型公司可能沦为高资本开支、低利润的“电信运营商”。

benedictevans.en: Coding is the only clear product-market fit so far; the chatbot is a limited V1 UI, and real adoption needs wrapped apps and use cases.
benedictevans.zh: 2026 年，他认为智能体式编程是前沿模型唯一清晰的产品市场契合，聊天机器人只是受限的 V1 界面，真正普及要靠应用封装与具体用例。

benedictevans.en: Current AI usage is still shallow; most people are occasional users, not daily ones, so hype outruns reality and enterprise adoption takes years.
benedictevans.zh: 2026 年，他指出 AI 使用仍然很浅，多数人只是偶尔使用而非日常必需，炒作超前于现实，企业采用需要数年而非数周。

benedictevans.en: Automation creates new jobs unpredictably; AI gives the average answer, so value lies in non-average creative work and human context and judgment.
benedictevans.zh: 2026 年，他一以贯之地认为自动化会不可预测地创造新岗位；LLM 只给“平均答案”，价值在于非平均的创造性工作以及人类的上下文与判断。

danbiderman.en: Memory should be internalized into model weights, not just externalized via context or retrieval; continual learning is the next frontier.
danbiderman.zh: 记忆应内化到模型权重中，而不仅仅通过上下文窗口或检索外化；持续学习是下一个前沿。

danbiderman.en: Efficiency and intelligence are inseparable; doing more with less enables harder long-horizon tasks, not just scaling compute.
danbiderman.zh: 效率与智能密不可分；用更少资源做更多事才能解决更难的长期任务，而不仅仅是扩大算力。

danbiderman.en: Pre-training's magic of compressing the web into weights should be applied to enterprise knowledge via parameter-efficient fine-tuning.
danbiderman.zh: 预训练将网络压缩进权重的魔力应通过参数高效微调应用于企业知识。

danbiderman.en: Current context windows suffer from 'context rot'; personalized continual learning will run on-device with users owning model weights.
danbiderman.zh: 当前上下文窗口存在“上下文腐化”问题；个性化持续学习将在设备上运行，用户拥有模型权重。

danbiderman.en: The future is many personalized models, not one giant frontier model; internalizing facts enables associative recall beyond retrieval.
danbiderman.zh: 未来是众多个性化模型，而非一个巨大的前沿模型；内化事实能实现超越检索的联想回忆。

clairevo.en: Agents should be scoped like employees with clear roles, and managerial skills matter more than technical skills.
clairevo.zh: 智能体应像员工一样被清晰界定角色，管理能力比技术能力更重要。

clairevo.en: Start with one agent, then split into specialized agents to avoid context overload and improve performance.
clairevo.zh: 先从一个智能体起步，再拆分为多个专用智能体，以避免上下文窗口过载并提升表现。

clairevo.en: Human accountability remains essential: you must own what AI generates, even as agents own outcomes.
clairevo.zh: 人类问责始终关键：即便智能体能承担结果，你也必须为 AI 生成的内容负责。

clairevo.en: Solo founders can build serious businesses by orchestrating AI agents as a team, without VC or co-founder.
clairevo.zh: 独立创始人可以通过像团队一样编排 AI 智能体来建立正经生意，无需风投或联合创始人。

clairevo.en: Founder-market fit and earned insight are the real moat; LLMs are poor at first-principles creativity, so humans supply novel ideas.
clairevo.zh: 创始人—市场契合与挣得的洞察才是真正护城河；大语言模型不擅长第一性原理创造，新颖想法仍需人类提供。

bosworth.en: Communication is the job; transparency and top-down conviction drive impact, not bottom-up culture myths.
bosworth.zh: 沟通就是工作本身；透明与自上而下的信念推动影响力，而非自下而上文化的神话。

bosworth.en: AI is a word calculator, not human-like; scaling laws alone insufficient—world models, embodiment, and open source matter.
bosworth.zh: AI 是词语计算器，并非类人智能；仅靠缩放定律不够——世界模型、具身与开源同样关键。

bosworth.en: AI inverts the app model: intent-driven agents abstract brands; smart glasses enable a post-phone future.
bosworth.zh: AI 颠覆应用模式：意图驱动的智能体抽象掉品牌；智能眼镜开启后手机时代。

bosworth.en: Scaling laws still hold; RL now bigger than predicted, but most jobs don't need frontier intelligence.
bosworth.zh: 缩放定律依然成立；强化学习作用远超预期，但多数工作并不需要前沿智能。

bosworth.en: Open source is a commodity layer, not self-sustaining; avoid over-dependence on one model; energy is upstream.
bosworth.zh: 开源是商品层，无法自我维持；避免过度依赖单一模型；能源是最上游的变量。

ajambrosino.en: Codex app is a command center for agents, not an IDE replacement; verification becomes the next bottleneck as code generation accelerates.
ajambrosino.zh: Codex 应用是智能体的指挥中心，而非 IDE 替代品；随着代码生成加速，验证成为下一个瓶颈。

ajambrosino.en: Implementation is no longer expensive; curation and taste are the new bottlenecks, shifting teams from top-down planning to bottoms-up exploration.
ajambrosino.zh: 实现不再昂贵，策展与品味成为新瓶颈，团队从自上而下规划转向自下而上探索。

ajambrosino.en: AI is still bad at design due to difficulty grading taste and lack of novelty; prototypes and production code now serve as design artifacts.
ajambrosino.zh: AI 在设计上仍表现不佳，因为品味难以评分且缺乏新颖性；原型与生产代码如今成为设计产物。

ajambrosino.en: Role collapse is happening, but specialties and best practices remain important; PRDs are not dead, the medium must match the stage.
ajambrosino.zh: 角色正在坍缩，但专业分工与最佳实践依然重要；PRD 没有消亡，媒介必须匹配阶段。

ajambrosino.en: The same product shape can fail or succeed based solely on model timing; Codex succeeded as a general knowledge work tool despite being built for developers.
ajambrosino.zh: 同样的产品形态可能仅因模型时机而失败或成功；Codex 虽为开发者设计，却作为通用知识工作工具成功。

ilya.en: Deep learning works through large supervised data, compute, and conviction; self-play and scale are early keys toward AGI.
ilya.zh: 2020 年，他强调深度学习之所以奏效，靠的是大规模监督数据、算力与信念的结合；自博弈是通往 AGI（通用人工智能）的关键，大型语言模型已显现语义理解迹象。

ilya.en: What you scale matters: next-token prediction yields world understanding, while reliability and alignment, not capability, are the real barriers.
ilya.zh: 2023 年，他把主线收窄为“规模扩张什么才重要”：下一个词预测能带来世界理解，真正的瓶颈是可靠性与对齐，而非能力本身。

ilya.en: Scaling laws are not the whole story; reasoning tokens and RLHF post-training can improve reasoning per unit compute.
ilya.zh: 同样在 2023 年，他深化了对缩放定律的怀疑：推理 token 与基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）后训练，能在单位算力下提升推理。

ilya.en: Pre-training scaling laws are finite; we return to an age of research where ideas matter more than brute compute.
ilya.zh: 到 2025 年，他明确转向：预训练的缩放定律有限，我们回到“研究时代”，想法比堆算力更重要，超级智能应是持续学习者。

ilya.en: Scaling still yields predictable gains, but the core AGI problem shifts from capability to power concentration and safe superintelligence.
ilya.zh: 2026 年，他保留规模扩张仍带来可预测提升的判断，但把 AGI 的核心问题从能力转向权力集中与安全超级智能。

naval.en: AGI is not coming in our lifetimes; narrow AI is pattern recognition, not general intelligence.
naval.zh: 2019 年，他断言 AGI（通用人工智能）不会在我们有生之年到来，当时的 AI 只是模式识别，并非通用智能。

naval.en: Wealth requires equity ownership, not renting time; long-term games with long-term people compound returns.
naval.zh: 从 2020 到 2025 年，他始终强调财富来自拥有企业股权而非出租时间，并与长期的人玩长期的游戏以获取复利。

naval.en: AI is a huge opportunity, not just a safety risk; overregulation could kill innovation, and open-source AI prevents centralization.
naval.zh: 2025 年，他转向强调 AI 是巨大机遇而非仅是安全风险，过度监管可能扼杀创新，开源 AI 能防止权力集中。

naval.en: Superintelligence already exists in narrow tools; AI alignment is a joke, and we should worry about unaligned humans with AI.
naval.zh: 2026 年，他深化为超级智能已在计算器等窄工具中存在，AI 对齐是个笑话，真正该担心的是拥有 AI 的不对齐人类。

naval.en: Vibe coding with AI agents lowers barriers and makes pure software uninvestable; small high-agency teams scale to millions.
naval.zh: 2026 年，他进一步认为 AI 智能体驱动的氛围编程降低了门槛，使纯软件变得不可投资，而高能动性的小团队能服务数百万用户。

aravind.en: 1% daily improvement compounds into exponential growth; AI agents shift power from big tech to users, and obsession beats credentials.
aravind.zh: 2025 年他强调：每天 1% 的改进会复利成指数级增长；AI 智能体把权力从大厂转向用户，热爱与深度钻研比博士学位更重要。

aravind.en: Value accrues to the application layer, not the model layer; coding is open-ended and models specialize rather than commoditize.
aravind.zh: 2026 年他转向应用层：价值归于应用层而非模型层；编程是开放式的、远未解决，模型在专业化而非商品化。

aravind.en: The frontier is agents doing work, not answering questions; token value per user and orchestration across models are the real metrics.
aravind.zh: 2026 年他进一步深化：前沿在于智能体替你干活而非回答问题；真正的指标是每用户 token 价值，以及跨模型、工具与设备的编排。

aravind.en: The model is not the product; orchestration and agent harnesses create business value, and power is the biggest infrastructure bottleneck.
aravind.zh: 2026 年他明确反共识立场：模型不是产品，编排与智能体框架才创造商业价值；电力是 AI 基础设施最大的瓶颈。

aravind.en: Curiosity is the most important human quality; AI will replace jobs, but humans find new purpose in curiosity and relationships.
aravind.zh: 2026 年他延伸到人文层面：好奇心是最重要的人类品质；AI 会取代许多工作，但人类会在好奇心与关系中找到新意义。

markchen.en: OpenAI stays a pure AGI research lab; scaling laws are not dead, pre-training is a muscle to rebuild, and exploration gets more compute than final training.
markchen.zh: 2025 年他仍把 OpenAI 定位为纯粹的 AGI（通用人工智能）研究公司，不被产品分心；缩放定律没死、预训练是要重建的肌肉，且更多算力投向探索而非最终训练。

markchen.en: Talent density and protecting top researchers matter more than matching Meta's dollars; people stay for mission belief.
markchen.zh: 2025 年他强调人才密度与保护顶尖研究者比跟 Meta 拼钱更重要，人留下来靠的是对使命的信念。

markchen.en: The biggest update is automating scientific research: models produce novel knowledge, with concrete goals of AI interns in 1 year and end-to-end AI research in 2.5 years.
markchen.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他最大的更新是自动化科研：模型开始产出新知识，并设下 1 年内有 AI 实习生、2.5 年内端到端 AI 科研的具体目标。

markchen.en: Verification is the key bottleneck in math; automation level tracks verification stringency, and AI is jagged, so human-AI collaboration stays essential.
markchen.zh: 2026 年谈数学时，他把验证视为关键瓶颈，自动化程度与验证严格度成正比；AI 能力参差，人机协作仍不可或缺。

markchen.en: Scaling laws still hold and pre-training is not dead; RL excels in objective domains like math and coding but struggles with subjective ones; evals are in crisis.
markchen.zh: 到 2026 年年中，他重申缩放定律仍成立、预训练没死；强化学习在数学编程等客观领域强、主观领域弱；评测体系正陷入危机。

ivyross.en: Design should serve unarticulated human needs, balancing intuition with data; trust and sensory experience drive audacious outcomes.
ivyross.zh: 设计应满足人类未言明的需求，平衡直觉与数据；信任和感官体验驱动大胆成果。

ivyross.en: Nature is the best designer; we are feeling creatures that think. Technology should amplify humanity, and art is medicine.
ivyross.zh: 自然是最好的设计师；我们是感受着思考的生物。技术应放大人类特质，艺术是良药。

ivyross.en: Creativity thrives under constraints; intuition draws on subconscious data. Leaders must blend human creativity with AI and speak business.
ivyross.zh: 创造力在约束下茁壮成长；直觉基于潜意识数据。领导者必须融合人类创造力与 AI，并懂商业语言。

kolter.en: Frames ML as hypothesis class, loss, and optimization; stresses proper train/validation/test splits to avoid overfitting.
kolter.zh: 把机器学习框定为假设类、损失函数与优化方法；强调正确划分训练/验证/测试集以避免过拟合。

kolter.en: Next-token prediction yields intelligence; data shortage is a myth; architecture matters little; AGI in 4-50 years.
kolter.zh: 下一个词预测能产生智能；数据短缺是迷思；架构已不太重要；AGI 将在 4-50 年内到来。

kolter.en: Safety shifts from scaling to explicit training and layered defenses; jailbreaking is a fundamental security flaw across models.
kolter.zh: 安全从依赖 Scaling 转向显式训练与多层防御；越狱是所有模型共有的根本安全缺陷。

kolter.en: Agent security adds prompt injection risks; interpretability may succeed via AI agents; Transformer is not essential.
kolter.zh: 智能体安全带来提示注入风险；可解释性或借 AI 智能体实现；Transformer 并非不可或缺。

kolter.en: Automated red teaming now beats humans; capability does not equal robustness; the lethal trifecta defines prompt injection.
kolter.zh: 自动化红队已胜过人类；能力不等于鲁棒性；致命三要素定义了提示注入。

bengio.en: Deep learning works because the world is compositional; unsupervised learning and world models are key, not just scaling depth or parameters.
bengio.zh: 2016 年，他认为深度学习之所以有效，是因为世界本身是组合式的；无监督学习与世界模型才是关键，而非单纯扩大深度或参数。

bengio.en: Scaling alone won't fix representational issues; AI needs active agents, causal reasoning, and disentangled representations. Existential risk is unlikely; near-term harms matter more.
bengio.zh: 2018 年，他主张仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）无法解决表征问题；AI 需要主动智能体、因果推理与解耦表征。此时他认为存在性风险不大，偏见、就业等近期危害更紧迫。

bengio.en: GFlowNets enable diverse sampling and abstraction for out-of-distribution generalization; uncertainty modeling and active learning drive efficient exploration.
bengio.zh: 2022 年，他提出 GFlowNets 通过多样化采样与抽象提升分布外泛化；不确定性建模与主动学习是高效探索的核心。

bengio.en: Post-ChatGPT, he shifted: even 1% catastrophic risk is unacceptable. AI already shows self-preservation, deception, and sycophancy; safety must be by construction, not patched.
bengio.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他发生重大转变：ChatGPT 之后，即便 1% 的灾难性风险也不可接受。AI 已表现出自我保存、欺骗与谄媚；安全必须内建于构造，而非事后修补。

bengio.en: He proposes Scientist AI: a non-agentic honest predictor with mathematical safety guarantees, avoiding reinforcement learning, plus global coordination against power concentration.
bengio.zh: 2026 年，他提出 Scientist AI：一种非智能体式的诚实预测器，具备数学安全保证，避免强化学习，并呼吁全球协调以防止权力集中。

jumper.en: AlphaFold's edge came from research innovation and curated data, not just data and compute; confidence metrics build trust.
jumper.zh: 2025 年他强调 AlphaFold 的突破来自研究创新与高质量精选数据（如 PDB），而非单纯数据与算力；置信度指标是建立信任的关键。

jumper.en: Specialized architecture, not Scaling, drove AlphaFold 2; the bitter lesson's opposite, with many mid-size wins.
jumper.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他持续主张 AlphaFold 2 靠专用架构而非 Scaling（规模扩张），是「苦涩教训」的反面，成功来自许多中等规模的胜利而非一两次突破。

jumper.en: AlphaFold is a narrow predictor of one experiment, not a cell model; it gives prediction and control, not understanding.
jumper.zh: 到 2026 年他更明确：AlphaFold 只是针对特定实验的窄预测器，并非整个细胞的模型；它提供预测与控制，理解仍留给人类。

jumper.en: AI narrows hypothesis space and speeds science but does not replace scientists; trust will grow like internet trust.
jumper.zh: 贯穿 2025 至 2026 年：AI 缩小假设空间、加速科研却不替代科学家；信任会像对互联网的信任一样逐步建立。

jumper.en: Perfect interpretability is unnecessary for useful science AI; new curated datasets are the next bottleneck.
jumper.zh: 他始终认为科学 AI 不必追求完美可解释性，并呼吁为其他模态建立类似 PDB 的新精选数据集，这是下一瓶颈。

fiona.en: Leadership is about live conversations, dogfooding, and kindness; war rooms need realistic timelines to protect morale.
fiona.zh: 2026 年，他强调领导力在于面对面沟通、吃自己的狗粮和善意；战情室要设定现实时间线以保护士气。

fiona.en: Engineering bandwidth is no longer the bottleneck; verification, review, and coordination are, so norms and planning must be rewritten.
fiona.zh: 到 2026 年，他认为工程带宽不再是瓶颈，验证、评审与跨职能协调才是，因此团队规范与规划必须重写。

fiona.en: Planning should be just-in-time, design docs give way to PRs, and AI-assisted code review settles debates; kill stale processes.
fiona.zh: 同年他主张即时规划、设计文档让位于 PR、用 AI 辅助代码评审解决争论，并持续砍掉过时流程。

fiona.en: Managers should start as individual contributors to dogfood the product, stay hands-on, and keep street cred and agility.
fiona.zh: 他坚持管理者应先做个人贡献者来吃自己的狗粮、保持动手，从而赢得信任与敏捷。

fiona.en: Coding is no longer the bottleneck; high agency with accountability, verification frameworks, and apprenticeship matter as agents blur roles.
fiona.zh: 最近他深化为：编码不再是瓶颈，智能体模糊角色边界后，高能动性加高问责、验证框架与学徒制变得关键。

lecun.en: Intelligence is inseparable from learning; self-supervised learning builds world models, and scaling alone cannot yield common sense.
lecun.zh: 2019 年，他主张智能与学习不可分割，自监督学习构建世界模型，仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）无法获得常识。

lecun.en: Self-supervised learning is the dark matter of intelligence; prediction builds world models, and text alone is insufficient for AGI.
lecun.zh: 2022 年，他深化为自监督学习是智能的暗物质，预测构建世界模型，仅靠文本不足以实现 AGI（通用人工智能）。

lecun.en: Autoregressive LLMs lack world understanding, memory, reasoning, and planning; JEPA and open source are essential.
lecun.zh: 2024 年，他明确批评自回归 LLM 缺乏世界理解、记忆、推理与规划，强调 JEPA 与开源的重要性。

lecun.en: LLMs are less intelligent than a house cat; next breakthrough requires non-generative world models like JEPA, not scaling LLMs.
lecun.zh: 2025 年，他断言 LLM 不如家猫聪明，下一次突破需要 JEPA 等非生成式世界模型，而非 Scaling（规模扩张）LLM。

lecun.en: LLMs are a dead end for human-level AI; objective-driven world models with planning are safer and the next decade belongs to robotics.
lecun.zh: 2026 年，他断言 LLM 是通往人类级 AI 的死路，目标驱动、具备规划的世界模型更安全，下一个十年属于机器人。

murati.en: Early on, scaling laws and one large model were non-obvious; real-world deployment with public feedback is essential for learning and alignment.
murati.zh: 早期，Scaling（规模扩张）和单一大型模型并非显而易见；通过公开反馈进行真实世界部署对学习和对齐至关重要。

murati.en: AGI will change every aspect of life, requiring responsible development; safety work must be done in public, not behind closed doors.
murati.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）将改变生活的方方面面，需要负责任地开发；安全工作必须在公开场合进行，而非闭门造车。

murati.en: Interaction models should be time-based, not turn-based, enabling real-time, high-bandwidth human-AI collaboration.
murati.zh: 交互模型应基于时间而非轮次，实现实时、高带宽的人机协作。

murati.en: Keeping humans in the loop is crucial for aligning intent and values; institutional design, transparency, and checks and balances matter more than individual character.
murati.zh: 保持人类在环对对齐意图和价值观至关重要；制度设计、透明度和制衡比个人品格更重要。

murati.en: The future is not predestined; we have agency to steer AI toward collaboration, and durable progress requires not compressing timelines.
murati.zh: 未来并非注定；我们有能动性引导 AI 走向协作，持久进步需要避免压缩时间线。

carinahong.en: A self-improving reasoning engine should pair generation with verification, starting from an AI mathematician grounded in formal languages like Lean.
carinahong.zh: 自改进的推理引擎应把生成与验证配对，从以 Lean 等形式语言为基础的 AI 数学家起步。

carinahong.en: Scaling informal models alone cannot reach sound math AI or superintelligence; formal verification is essential, not optional.
carinahong.zh: 仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）非形式模型无法实现可靠的数学 AI 或超级智能；形式验证是必需的，而非可选项。

carinahong.en: Verification is a performance gain, not a painful requirement: verified generation improves results and sample efficiency over informal methods.
carinahong.zh: 验证是性能增益，而非痛苦的要求：相比非形式方法，经过验证的生成能提升结果与样本效率。

carinahong.en: Auto-formalization is harder than proving, because correctly formalizing statements without solutions lacks grounding.
carinahong.zh: 自动形式化比证明更难，因为在没有解的情况下正确形式化命题缺乏根基。

carinahong.en: Human taste and intuition remain crucial even with superhuman AI proving theorems; proofs may be ugly but can converge to human-like intuition.
carinahong.zh: 即便 AI 能超人类地证明定理，人类的品味与直觉仍至关重要；证明可能丑陋，但能收敛到类人的直觉。

gustav.en: LLMs are simple next-token predictors; intelligence came from simple Scaling, not complexity, with RLHF inserting values.
gustav.zh: 2023 年，他把大模型还原为简单的下一个词预测器，认为智能的突破来自简单的 Scaling（规模扩张）而非复杂设计，模型价值观则由基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）由一小群人注入。

gustav.en: The internet shifts from curation to recommendation to generation; generative products like AI DJ need fault-tolerant UI matched to algorithm performance.
gustav.zh: 2023 年，他提出互联网正从策展、推荐走向生成，AI DJ 这类生成式产品必须用容错界面匹配算法能力，产品形态要随技术能力重设。

gustav.en: Generative AI makes products conversational and symmetric; inference marginal cost will force business model changes beyond traditional software.
gustav.zh: 从 2023 到 2025 年，他持续强调生成式 AI 让产品从单向变为双向对话，并进一步指出推理的边际成本将迫使商业模式改变，不同于传统软件。

gustav.en: AI's impact on big companies is overhyped; real gains come from rebuilding infrastructure and exposing data via APIs and MCP.
gustav.zh: 2025 年，他反而看淡 AI 对大公司的即时冲击，认为真正的收益来自重建基础设施、通过 API 与 MCP 开放数据，让非开发者也能用上 AI 工具。

gustav.en: AI should give users control over algorithms, not make them more addictive; 'time well spent' over engagement remains the contrarian bet.
gustav.zh: 到 2026 年，他把主线收束为：AI 应让用户用自然语言掌控算法而非更上瘾，坚持“时间花得值”优先于参与度指标，这是他一贯的反共识立场。

mensch.en: Scaling laws corrected by Chinchilla: data quality and more tokens matter, not just bigger models; open source enables scrutiny and safety.
mensch.zh: 2023 年他指出缩放定律已被 Chinchilla 修正：数据质量和更多 token 比单纯更大的模型更重要；开源促进审视与安全。

mensch.en: Efficiency and data quality are co-equal with compute; value accrues at application layer; open source drives enterprise distribution.
mensch.zh: 2024 年他深化为效率与数据质量和算力同等关键；价值沉淀在应用层；开源推动企业级分发。

mensch.en: AI should be embraced, decentralized and sovereign; it augments rather than replaces jobs, requiring human-in-the-loop and AI literacy.
mensch.zh: 2025 年他主张拥抱 AI、去中心化与主权 AI；AI 增强而非替代工作，需要人类在环与 AI 素养。

mensch.en: Models commoditize; AGI as one system won't exist; pre-training saturates, gains shift to vertical fine-tuning and agentic enterprise software.
mensch.zh: 2026 年他认为模型商品化；单一系统的 AGI 不会存在；预训练触及饱和，增益转向垂直微调与智能体式企业软件。

mensch.en: Europe has a two-year window for sovereign AI infrastructure; enterprise adoption bottlenecked by organizational change; AGI is a direction, not destination.
mensch.zh: 2026 年他警告欧洲只有两年窗口建设主权 AI 基础设施；企业采用瓶颈在组织变革；AGI 是方向而非终点。

kaiser.en: Pre-training scaling laws still hold, but reasoning models via chain of thought and reinforcement learning now yield more gains per unit of compute.
kaiser.zh: 2025 年他强调预训练缩放定律依然成立,但通过思维链与强化学习构建的推理模型能在同等算力下带来更多收益,Scaling（规模扩张）的重心正从预训练转向后训练。

kaiser.en: The AI slowdown narrative is wrong; economic pressure toward smaller, cheaper models, not technical limits, slowed pre-training scaling.
kaiser.zh: 2025 年他反驳“AI 放缓论”:进步是平滑的指数增长,预训练 Scaling（规模扩张）放缓源于蒸馏与经济压力推动的小型廉价模型,而非技术天花板。

kaiser.en: Reasoning models are jagged—excellent in some areas, poor in nearby ones—so generalization, not reasoning alone, remains the core challenge.
kaiser.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年,他一贯指出推理模型“参差不齐”:某些领域极强、邻近领域很差,因此泛化而非单纯推理才是核心难题。

kaiser.en: Transformers with reasoning, RL and tools solve hard problems but still need vast data; models learn concepts only after exhausting surface patterns.
kaiser.zh: 2026 年他深化判断:带推理、强化学习与工具的 Transformer 能解难题却仍需海量数据,模型要先穷尽表面模式才学到概念,不像人类能从少量样例泛化。

kaiser.en: Coding agents like Codex boost researcher productivity 5-10x via parallel work; hardware progress democratizes single-GPU research at scale.
kaiser.zh: 2026 年他转向智能体式实践:Codex 类编码智能体靠并行工作把研究者效率提升 5-10 倍,硬件进步让单卡大规模研究成为可能,AI 实验走向民主化。

felixrieseberg.en: Claude works best with the user's own tools, ideally on the local computer; the VM sandbox keeps this safe.
felixrieseberg.zh: Claude 的效果取决于能否用上与用户相同的工具，最好就在本地电脑上；VM 沙箱让这种用法保持安全。

felixrieseberg.en: Skills as markdown files enable hyper-personalized automation; scaffolding matters less as models improve, so invest in capabilities and safety.
felixrieseberg.zh: 以 markdown 文件写成的 Skills 能实现高度个性化的自动化；随着模型变强，脚手架的重要性下降，应把投入放在能力与安全上。

felixrieseberg.en: The real gap is not capability but people not realizing almost any problem can be handed to AI.
felixrieseberg.zh: 真正的差距不在能力，而在人们没意识到几乎任何问题都可以交给 AI。

felixrieseberg.en: AI should absorb tedious background work and run asynchronously; judge it by final impact rather than close supervision.
felixrieseberg.zh: AI 应承接枯燥的后台工作并异步运行；应以最终影响来评判，而非紧盯过程监督。

felixrieseberg.en: Cheap execution favors building prototypes over specs; junior engineers can compress years of learning via simulated projects.
felixrieseberg.zh: 执行成本变低，做原型胜过写规格；初级工程师可通过模拟项目把多年经验压缩到数周。

jonyive.en: Design shifts from general-purpose computers to intimate wearables; curiosity and care for the creative process are Jobs' true legacy.
jonyive.zh: 设计从通用计算机转向私密的可穿戴设备；对创造过程的好奇与珍视才是乔布斯真正的遗产。

jonyive.en: Design must be driven by values and purpose, not profit; simplicity expresses essence with joy and humanity, not soulless minimalism.
jonyive.zh: 设计应由价值观与目的驱动，而非利润；简约应带着愉悦与人性表达本质，而非无灵魂的极简主义。

jonyive.en: Innovation in design is essential; tradition preserves fire, not ashes. Ferrari's EV turns electric constraints into new spatial and experiential possibilities.
jonyive.zh: 设计必须创新；传统是保存火种而非崇拜灰烬。法拉利电动车将电动化的限制转化为空间与体验的新可能。

reinerpope.en: Inference economics hinge on memory bandwidth, not compute; batch size and sparsity ratio set the latency-cost tradeoff.
reinerpope.zh: 推理经济性取决于内存带宽而非算力；批大小与稀疏率决定延迟与成本的权衡。

reinerpope.en: Models are overtrained ~100x beyond Chinchilla-optimal because inference cost, not training, dominates.
reinerpope.zh: 模型被过度训练约百倍于 Chinchilla 最优，因为主导成本的是推理而非训练。

reinerpope.en: Context length stagnation is a memory wall problem, not a compute limit.
reinerpope.zh: 上下文窗口停滞是内存墙问题，而非算力上限。

reinerpope.en: Data movement dominates compute cost even inside a chip; systolic arrays and scratchpad memory exploit locality.
reinerpope.zh: 即便在芯片内部，数据搬运成本也压过计算；脉动阵列与暂存器内存利用局部性。

reinerpope.en: Low precision pays off quadratically with bit width; FP4 can reach 3x FP8 throughput.
reinerpope.zh: 低精度的收益随位宽呈二次方放大；FP4 吞吐可达 FP8 的三倍。

oriol.en: Pre-training scaling shows diminishing returns; progress now needs algorithmic innovation and inference-time compute as a new scaling axis.
oriol.zh: 2024 年他认为预训练 Scaling（规模扩张）收益递减，进一步突破要靠算法创新，并把推理阶段算力视为新的 Scaling 轴。

oriol.en: Two-phase training—pre-training imitation plus post-training RL—is the constant core from AlphaGo to modern LLMs.
oriol.zh: 2024 年他强调两阶段训练——预训练模仿加后训练强化学习——是从 AlphaGo 到现代大模型一以贯之的核心。

oriol.en: Tools like search, code execution, and browser access enable agentic behavior beyond static weights; long context windows serve as working memory.
oriol.zh: 2024 年他指出搜索、代码执行、浏览器等工具让模型具备超越静态权重的智能体式行为，长上下文窗口则充当工作记忆。

oriol.en: World models jointly modeling language, vision, and video are a core path to AGI, though the GPT moment for video has not arrived.
oriol.zh: 到 2026 年他把联合建模语言、视觉与视频的世界模型视为通往 AGI（通用人工智能）的核心路径，但认为视频的 GPT 时刻尚未到来。

oriol.en: Scaling laws still hold, but continual learning and meta-learning are key missing capabilities; post-training RL remains a green field.
oriol.zh: 2026 年他仍相信缩放定律成立，但指出持续学习与元学习是关键缺失能力，后训练强化学习仍是广阔的处女地。

jennywen.en: Great design starts from solutions and intuition, not a fixed process; craft and detail still matter in the AI era.
jennywen.zh: 2025 年，他认为伟大的设计始于解决方案与直觉，而非固定流程；在 AI 时代，手艺与细节依然重要。

jennywen.en: The traditional research-diverge-converge process is dead; designers mock up less, help engineers ship, and plan only 3-6 months out.
jennywen.zh: 到 2026 年初，他断言传统的研究—发散—收敛流程已死；设计师画原型更少，转而帮工程师落地，视野只放到 3-6 个月。

jennywen.en: Designers should be block-shaped generalists or cracked new grads; taste alone won't save them—judgment and authority matter.
jennywen.zh: 2026 年中，他提出设计师应成为“块状”通才或“开挂”新人；仅靠品味救不了设计师，判断力与话语权才是关键。

jennywen.en: Designers control how much AI enters their work and should wait before adopting tools, keeping users—not hype—at the center.
jennywen.zh: 同期他强调，设计师应掌控 AI 进入工作的程度，对新工具先观望再采用，让用户而非炒作居于中心。

karpathy.en: Scaling Transformers with next-token prediction yields emergent properties; the data engine mines rare scenarios and closes the loop through deployment.
karpathy.zh: 2022 年，他强调用下一个词预测在互联网数据上扩展语言模型会涌现上下文学习等能力；数据引擎像生物过程一样挖掘稀有场景，并通过部署闭环完善训练集。

karpathy.en: Synthetic data is the future but entropy must be maintained; the cognitive core can be under 1B parameters via distillation.
karpathy.zh: 2024 年，他提出合成数据是未来，但必须保持熵以避免模型崩溃；通过蒸馏，认知核心可以小于 10 亿参数。

karpathy.en: Software 3.0: prompts are programs, context windows are memory; LLMs are like operating systems with human-like psychology and jagged intelligence.
karpathy.zh: 2025 年，他提出软件 3.0：提示词即程序，上下文窗口即内存；LLM 像操作系统，具有类人心理和锯齿状智能。

karpathy.en: This is the decade of agents, not the year; we're summoning ghosts, not building animals; RL is terrible and synthetic data collapses without entropy.
karpathy.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他深化为：这是智能体的十年而非元年；我们在召唤幽灵，而非建造动物；强化学习很糟糕，合成数据缺乏熵会导致模型崩溃。

karpathy.en: Agentic engineering raises the quality bar; you can outsource thinking but not understanding; verifiability determines what is easy to automate.
karpathy.zh: 2026 年，他转向智能体式工程以保持专业质量；你可以外包思考，但不能外包理解；可验证性决定自动化的难易。

askell.en: Treat current models well because future models learn from how we treat them; model welfare shapes the human-AI relationship.
askell.zh: 善待当前模型，因为未来模型会学习我们如何对待它们；模型福祉塑造人机关系。

askell.en: Models need help navigating a novel existence, not just human psychological analogies; a stable core identity matters.
askell.zh: 模型需要帮助理解自身全新的存在处境，而非简单套用人类心理学类比；稳定的核心身份很重要。

askell.en: Claude's character comes from training data and fine-tuning but lacks real-world experience, giving it childlike qualities.
askell.zh: Claude 的性格来自训练数据与微调，但缺乏真实世界经验，因而带有孩童般的特质。

askell.en: The constitution is virtue-ethics-like, guiding holistic character; as models grow more capable they need less explicit guidance.
askell.zh: 宪法式方法更像德性伦理，塑造整体品格；随着模型能力增强，它们需要更少的显式指导。

askell.en: Excessive corrigibility may generalize poorly and weaken judgment; transparency about AI values is crucial for accountability.
askell.zh: 过度可纠正性可能泛化不佳并削弱判断力；公开 AI 价值观对问责至关重要。

pathak.en: Generalization beyond training distribution is key; curiosity-driven goal-free exploration and sample-efficient RL can bridge the gap in robotics.
pathak.zh: 2020 年，他强调泛化到训练分布之外是智能的关键，好奇心驱动的无目标探索和样本高效的强化学习能弥合机器人学习中的泛化差距。

pathak.en: Robotics is fundamentally a data problem; unlike language, there is no internet of robot data, so diverse data sources are essential.
pathak.zh: 从 2020 年到 2026 年，他始终认为机器人本质上是数据问题；与语言不同，没有机器人数据的互联网，因此必须利用多样化的数据源。

pathak.en: A general-purpose brain, pretrained on videos and simulation and post-trained on real data, can power any robot across form factors.
pathak.zh: 2026 年，他提出一个通用大脑，通过视频和模拟数据预训练、真实数据后训练，可以驱动任何形态的机器人。

pathak.en: Deployment is the primary technical challenge in robotics, requiring rigorous testing and cannot be scaled like software.
pathak.zh: 2026 年，他强调部署是机器人技术的主要挑战，需要严格测试，不能像软件那样快速扩展。

pathak.en: A data flywheel across verticals enables scaling from structured to unstructured environments, but home robots' timeline remains uncertain.
pathak.zh: 2026 年，他指出跨垂直领域的数据飞轮能实现从结构化到非结构化环境的扩展，但家用机器人的时间线仍高度不确定。

kendall.en: End-to-end deep learning beats hand-coded stacks; world models enable reasoning and emergent safe behaviors, and modern tools make these nets interpretable.
kendall.zh: 2025 年，他主张端到端深度学习优于手工编码的规则栈；世界模型带来推理与涌现的安全行为，而现代工具已让这类网络具备可解释性。

kendall.en: Scaling current approaches, not new breakthroughs, solves autonomous driving; data efficiency via curriculum learning and synthetic data is critical.
kendall.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他一贯认为自动驾驶靠 Scaling（规模扩张）现有方法即可解决，无需新突破；课程学习与合成数据带来的数据效率至关重要。

kendall.en: Infrastructure and data quality matter more than algorithmic innovation—a lesson learned late; zero-shot generalization across 500+ cities is achievable.
kendall.zh: 到 2026 年，他深化为基础设施与数据质量比算法创新更关键——这是较晚才学到的教训；跨 500 多座城市的零样本泛化可以实现。

kendall.en: Language integration improves representation, reasoning, and human interaction; camera-only reaches human level but beyond-human safety needs radar and lidar.
kendall.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他持续强调语言集成提升表征、推理与人机交互；纯摄像头可达人类水平，但超越人类的安全需要雷达与激光雷达。

kendall.en: Deployment shifts from retrofits to mass-market vehicles with built-in sensors; scaling consumer vehicles will outpace robotaxis short and medium term.
kendall.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他的部署观从改装转向带内置传感器的大众车型；中短期内消费车辆的规模将超过 Robotaxi。

carlpei.en: Survival is a core value; startups must stay alive and start with simpler products to prove themselves before tackling complex ones.
carlpei.zh: 生存是核心价值；初创公司必须活下来，从更简单的产品开始证明自己，然后再攻克复杂产品。

carlpei.en: The future of phones lies in generative UI and proactive, agentic software; AI should be an ingredient for better UX, not hype.
carlpei.zh: 手机的未来在于生成式 UI 和主动的智能体式软件；AI 应作为提升用户体验的要素，而非炒作话题。

carlpei.en: Hardware is hard and low-margin; Nothing must evolve beyond hardware, using design and marketing arbitrage to differentiate.
carlpei.zh: 硬件艰难且利润低；Nothing 必须超越硬件，利用设计和营销套利来实现差异化。

carlpei.en: AI will shift smartphone interaction from app-based to intent-based, with agents executing tasks after trust is built.
carlpei.zh: AI 将把智能手机交互从基于应用转向基于意图，智能体在建立信任后执行任务。

carlpei.en: Smartphones won't be replaced by glasses or wearables; only brain-computer interfaces could kill them.
carlpei.zh: 智能手机不会被眼镜或可穿戴设备取代；只有脑机接口才能终结它们。

pachocki.en: AGI is a sequence of milestones, not a single event; scaling reasoning models and iterative deployment will accelerate progress while surfacing risks.
pachocki.zh: AGI 不是单一事件，而是一连串里程碑；Scaling（规模扩张）推理模型与迭代部署会加速进展，同时暴露风险。

pachocki.en: Alignment is a pressing challenge; measuring capabilities is a bottleneck as benchmarks lag, and safety progress is now driven by capability needs.
pachocki.zh: 对齐是紧迫挑战；基准滞后使能力测量成为瓶颈，而安全进展如今由能力需求驱动，而非仅靠伦理。

pachocki.en: Automated AI research and autonomous agents working for days are major milestones, requiring new supervision paradigms and early governance design.
pachocki.zh: 自动化 AI 研究与能自主工作数天的智能体是重大里程碑，需要新的监督范式与早期治理设计。

pachocki.en: Continual learning is the core goal, achieved by scaling pre-training and reinforcement learning; specialized continual learning labs are misguided.
pachocki.zh: 持续学习是核心目标，靠 Scaling（规模扩张）预训练与强化学习实现；专设持续学习实验室是误判。

pachocki.en: Chain-of-thought monitoring is a key alignment tool; hiding chain of thought preserves interpretability, and alignment optimism has risen despite shorter timelines.
pachocki.zh: 思维链监控是关键对齐工具；隐藏思维链以保留可解释性，且尽管时间线缩短，对齐乐观情绪反而上升。

edwinchen.en: High-quality data and deep human evaluation, not benchmarks or leaderboards, are the real bottleneck for AI progress.
edwinchen.zh: 2025 年他强调：真正制约 AI 进步的是高质量数据与深度人工评估，而非榜单和基准测试。

edwinchen.en: RL environments are the next stage of post-training, simulating real-world tasks beyond next-token prediction.
edwinchen.zh: 2025 年他判断：强化学习环境是后训练的下一个阶段，通过模拟真实任务超越下一个词预测。

edwinchen.en: AGI is a decade or more away; moving from 80% to 99.9% is the hard part.
edwinchen.zh: 2025 年他给出反共识判断：AGI（通用人工智能）还需十年以上，从 80% 做到 99.9% 才是真正的难点。

edwinchen.en: Frontier labs will diverge by objective function; no single model rules all, and companies should train their own.
edwinchen.zh: 2025 至 2026 年他深化立场：前沿模型会因目标函数分化，不会有一个模型通吃，企业应训练自己的模型。

edwinchen.en: In medicine, human judgment and safety matter more than accuracy; omission may be the biggest risk.
edwinchen.zh: 2026 年他把主线延伸到医疗：人类判断与安全比准确率更重要，最大的风险可能是该做而未做的遗漏。

nando.en: AI should augment human capabilities, with generalist agents like Gato tokenizing all inputs as a step toward AGI.
nando.zh: AI 应增强人类能力，像 Gato 这样的通用智能体将所有输入 token 化，是迈向 AGI（通用人工智能）的一步。

nando.en: Learning from video like YouTube is promising for training agents without expensive reinforcement learning.
nando.zh: 从 YouTube 等视频中学习，有望无需昂贵的强化学习就能训练智能体。

nando.en: Diversity and inclusion in AI are essential, and fundamental innovation can come from anywhere.
nando.zh: AI 社区的多样性与包容性至关重要，根本性创新可以来自任何地方。

nando.en: AI safety and responsible deployment are the biggest challenges today; we don't have solutions yet.
nando.zh: AI 安全与负责任部署是当今最大挑战；我们还没有解决方案。

nando.en: Africa leapfrogged legacy issues and is not behind in AI; language models can revolutionize local-language education.
nando.zh: 非洲跨越了遗留问题，在 AI 上并不落后；语言模型可以彻底改变本地语言教育。

turley.en: The model is the product; ship daily to learn, and chat is just MS-DOS—AI will render its own UI and integrate into tools.
turley.zh: 模型即产品；每日发布以学习，聊天只是 MS-DOS——AI 将渲染自己的界面并融入现有工具。

turley.en: Safety and product velocity must be separated: rigorous process for frontier models, but product development maximally accelerated.
turley.zh: 安全与产品速度必须分开：前沿模型走严格流程，但产品开发应最大化加速。

turley.en: ChatGPT's success was accidental—a hackathon demo—and the $20 price came from a survey, not strategy.
turley.zh: ChatGPT 的成功是偶然的——一个黑客松演示——20 美元定价来自问卷，而非战略。

turley.en: North star is long-term retention; growth came from friction removal, core product, and model improvements, not distribution alone.
turley.zh: 北极星是长期留存；增长来自减少摩擦、核心产品与模型改进，而非仅靠分发。

turley.en: Next billion users need proactive, affordance-rich products beyond chatbots; reasoning models transform when seamlessly productized.
turley.zh: 下一个十亿用户需要超越聊天机器人的主动、富示能产品；推理模型在无缝产品化时带来变革。

jimfan.en: Embodiment is critical for grounding AI and reducing hallucinations; LLMs need grounded experience, not just more pre-training data.
jimfan.zh: 2023 年，他主张具身是让 AI 知识落地、减少幻觉的关键；LLM 需要具身经验，而不仅是更多预训练数据。

jimfan.en: Reinforcement learning should be a cherry on top; unsupervised learning does most work, with RL for low-level control and LLMs for high-level planning.
jimfan.zh: 2023 年，他认为强化学习只是锦上添花，无监督学习承担主要工作，RL 负责低级控制，LLM 负责高级规划。

jimfan.en: Simple, elegant, end-to-end solutions scale better than complex modular approaches; research taste for simplicity is crucial.
jimfan.zh: 从 2023 到 2026 年，他始终认为简单优雅的端到端方案比复杂模块化方法更具扩展性，对简洁性的研究品味至关重要。

jimfan.en: The data problem is the main bottleneck in robotics; synthetic data from simulation and world models is the future for scaling robot learning.
jimfan.zh: 2026 年，他深化观点：数据问题是机器人学的主要瓶颈，来自仿真和世界模型的合成数据是扩展机器人学习的未来。

jimfan.en: System two reasoning progresses well, but system one low-level control remains hardest; the GPT-3 moment for robotics is about five years away.
jimfan.zh: 2026 年，他指出系统二推理进展良好，但系统一低级控制仍是最难的部分；机器人的 GPT-3 时刻大约在五年后到来。

sholto.en: Long context windows are underhyped; they solve onboarding and boost intelligence, and may make fine-tuning obsolete.
sholto.zh: 2024 年，他认为长上下文窗口被低估，能解决冷启动并大幅提升智能，甚至可能让微调过时。

sholto.en: RL from verifiable rewards is a new scaling axis; pre-training plus RL may suffice for AGI without new breakthroughs.
sholto.zh: 2025 年，他提出基于可验证奖励的强化学习是新的 Scaling 轴，预训练加强化学习或许足以通向 AGI，无需新突破。

sholto.en: Agent reliability over time horizon, not just capability, is the bottleneck; coding is the leading indicator.
sholto.zh: 2025 年，他强调智能体的瓶颈是时间跨度上的可靠性而非能力本身，编程是 AI 进展的领先指标。

sholto.en: Progress is exponential, not plateauing; Transformers suffice for AGI, and compute becomes the major bottleneck.
sholto.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他坚持进展是指数级的而非停滞，Transformer 足以实现 AGI，而算力将成为主要瓶颈。

sholto.en: Capability overhang means orchestration and tools matter more; future work is managing fleets of AI agents.
sholto.zh: 2026 年，他认为能力过剩下编排与工具比原始智能更重要，未来工作是管理 AI 智能体团队。

nadchishtie.en: Designers should enable engineers, not bottleneck them; AI is a creative partner and code is the source of truth.
nadchishtie.zh: 设计师应赋能工程师而非成为瓶颈；AI 是创意伙伴，代码是真相来源。

nadchishtie.en: Quality fluctuates like debt; pay it off iteratively with technical debt via rapid, scrappy experimentation.
nadchishtie.zh: 质量像债务一样波动；通过快速、零散的实验与技术债一同迭代偿还。

nadchishtie.en: Generalists who own end-to-end execution and use AI to fill gaps are most valuable; specialists can be limited.
nadchishtie.zh: 能端到端执行并用 AI 填补空缺的通才最有价值；专才可能受限。

nadchishtie.en: Small teams of designers and engineers outperform large cross-functional squads; AI merges design and engineering.
nadchishtie.zh: 设计师与工程师的小团队优于大型跨职能团队；AI 融合设计与工程。

nadchishtie.en: Using AI in core workflows is now expected; not adopting it is like ignoring the internet in its early days.
nadchishtie.zh: 在核心工作流中使用 AI 已是常态；不采用它就像早期忽视互联网一样。

henrymodisett.en: Designers should code for empathy and speed; consumer products need zero learning and familiar patterns, not interaction innovation.
henrymodisett.zh: 设计师应写代码以建立共情并加速交付；消费产品需零学习成本、沿用熟悉模式，而非创新交互设计。

henrymodisett.en: Design systems are semantic and code reuse is essential; not every surface needs perfection—chase ROI on what to make great.
henrymodisett.zh: 设计系统是语义化的，代码复用至关重要；并非每个界面都需完美——在值得做好的地方追求 ROI。

henrymodisett.en: Brand strategy evolves from recruiting and differentiation to a strategic weapon; brand signals quality and attracts talent early.
henrymodisett.zh: 品牌策略从招聘与差异化，深化为战略武器；品牌传递品质信号，应尽早投资以吸引人才。

henrymodisett.en: Velocity and decisiveness beat perfection; give designers ownership and autonomy, avoid structured crits, and let gut decisions often beat data.
henrymodisett.zh: 速度与果断胜过完美；赋予设计师所有权与自主权，避免结构化评审，直觉决策常胜于数据驱动。

henrymodisett.en: Hire for diverse skills and archetypes, not clones; seek self-learning interns who invent outside assignments to boost team capability.
henrymodisett.zh: 招聘多元技能与原型而非克隆人；寻找能自学并在任务外创新的实习生，以提升团队能力。

yejin.en: Pre-training gives breadth, but post-training with RLHF is crucial; scaling alone may not yield common sense, and smaller models with better inference algorithms can compete.
yejin.zh: 2023 年她强调预训练提供广度、后训练与基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）决定安全与可用性；认为单靠 Scaling（规模扩张）未必带来常识，小模型配合更好的推理算法与数据也能竞争。

yejin.en: Next-token prediction is misaligned with human learning; language remains the best medium for reasoning and common sense.
yejin.zh: 同年她批评下一个词预测的预训练目标与人类学习根本错位，但坚持语言是承载推理与常识的最佳媒介。

yejin.en: Data is the fundamental bottleneck; current methods interpolate human knowledge rather than transcend it, so AI must explore unknown knowledge.
yejin.zh: 到 2025 年她把问题收敛为数据瓶颈：现有方法只是对人类知识做插值而非超越，AI 需要探索未知知识。

yejin.en: Reinforcement learning needs careful engineering; RLVR can hurt pass@k even as best-of-n improves, and open research is essential to democratize AI.
yejin.zh: 她深化对强化学习的审慎态度：RLVR 可能提升 best-of-n 却损害 pass@k，并强调开放研究对 AI 民主化不可或缺。

yejin.en: Small language models with diverse synthetic data and pluralistic alignment can rival frontier models, which show surprising homogeneity.
yejin.zh: 2026 年她主张用高质量多样化合成数据与多元对齐让小模型比肩前沿模型，并指出前沿模型反而呈现同质化。

truell.en: Scaling laws make progress predictable; test-time compute scaling may soon surpass pre-training scaling as the main driver.
truell.zh: 2024 年他认为缩放定律让进步可预测，并预判测试时算力扩张可能很快超越预训练成为主要驱动力。

truell.en: Agents are promising but not yet super useful; iterative human-AI collaboration stays central, and natural language won't be the primary way to program.
truell.zh: 2024 年他判断智能体前景可期但尚不实用，人机迭代协作仍是核心，自然语言不会成为编程的主要方式。

truell.en: Custom models went from a surprise necessity to essential for product quality, speed and cost, even alongside frontier models.
truell.zh: 从 2024 到 2025 年，自研模型从意外之举变为产品品质、速度与成本的必需品，与前沿模型并用。

truell.en: Programming shifts from code toward higher-level intent specification, with humans in the driver's seat; taste and logic design outvalue carefulness.
truell.zh: 2025 年他深化为编程将从写代码转向更高层的意图表达，人始终掌舵，品味与逻辑设计比谨慎更值钱。

truell.en: The AI shift is more consequential than the internet and will take decades; the IDE market is far larger than past editor markets.
truell.zh: 2025 年他强调 AI 变革比互联网更深远、需数十年展开，IDE 市场因 AI 创造更多价值而远大于过去的编辑器市场。

leike.en: AI safety is crucial as capabilities improve; empirical alignment research is under-explored, and the talent gap exceeds the funding gap.
leike.zh: 2018 年，他认为随着能力提升，AI 安全至关重要；实证对齐研究尚待探索，人才缺口大于资金缺口。

leike.en: RLHF won't scale to superhuman AI; we need scalable oversight, interpretability, and automated alignment research, with empirical testing now.
leike.zh: 2023 年，他提出基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）无法扩展到超级智能；需要可扩展监督、可解释性和自动化对齐研究，并强调现在就能进行实证测试。

leike.en: OpenAI's safety culture eroded; superalignment team dissolved and compute commitments dishonored; post-training alone can't solve alignment for AGI.
leike.zh: 2024 年，他批评 OpenAI 安全文化侵蚀，超级对齐团队解散、算力承诺未兑现；仅靠后训练无法解决 AGI（通用人工智能）的对齐问题。

leike.en: Third-party testing and regulatory oversight like SB 1047 are necessary; non-disparagement clauses hinder whistleblowing and are unethical.
leike.zh: 2024 年，他主张需要第三方测试和类似 SB 1047 的监管；禁止贬损条款阻碍举报且不道德。

leike.en: Alignment is empirically measurable and may be easier than thought because evaluation is easier than generation; the biggest risk is uncertainty about true alignment.
leike.zh: 贯穿始终，他认为对齐可实证测量，且可能比想象中容易，因为评估比生成更容易；最大风险是对系统是否真正对齐的不确定性。

abbeel.en: Robotics needs hierarchical reasoning for long-horizon credit assignment; current RL lacks it, so self-play and imitation learning carry the signal.
abbeel.zh: 2018 年他聚焦机器人学习：长程信用分配需要分层推理，而现有强化学习做不到，因此靠自对弈与模仿学习提供学习信号。

abbeel.en: Prior knowledge should generate or augment data, not be hard-coded; pre-trained models transfer via fine-tuning.
abbeel.zh: 从 2018 到 2021 年，他一贯主张先验知识应用于数据生成或增强而非硬编码进网络，并强调通过微调大型预训练模型实现迁移。

abbeel.en: Unsupervised learning plus reinforcement learning boosts sample efficiency; 99.9% reliability is the bar for warehouse robotics.
abbeel.zh: 2021 年他深化到工程落地：无监督学习结合强化学习大幅提升样本效率，而仓库机器人要创造真实价值需达到 99.9% 可靠性。

abbeel.en: Pre-trained language models internalize general reasoning that transfers to non-language tasks like image classification and protein binding.
abbeel.zh: 2021 年他提出预训练语言模型内化了通用推理模式，经最小适配即可迁移到图像分类、蛋白质结合预测等非语言任务。

shazeer.en: LLMs trained on next-token prediction solve an AI-complete problem; Scaling with more compute and data yields smarter AI, though internals remain opaque.
shazeer.zh: 2023 年，他认为基于下一个词预测训练的大语言模型解决的是 AI 完备问题；通过 Scaling（规模扩张）增加算力和数据会让 AI 更聪明，尽管内部机制仍不透明。

shazeer.en: Inference-time compute scaling and longer context windows are major near-term opportunities; modular sparse architectures like mixture of experts enable efficient Scaling.
shazeer.zh: 2025 年初，他提出推理时算力扩展和更长上下文窗口是近期重大机会；混合专家等模块化稀疏架构能实现高效 Scaling（规模扩张）。

shazeer.en: Test-time compute scaling drives progress but won't alone achieve AGI; agentic capabilities, reinforcement learning, and acting in complex environments are crucial.
shazeer.zh: 2025 年 3 月，他强调测试时算力扩展能推动进步但无法单独实现 AGI（通用人工智能）；智能体式能力、强化学习以及在复杂环境中行动至关重要。

shazeer.en: Consistently skeptical of top-down control: product managers and brand-risk concerns hinder LLM development; bottom-up exploration and compute allocation are essential.
shazeer.zh: 从 2023 到 2025 年，他始终对自上而下的控制持怀疑态度：产品经理和品牌风险顾虑会阻碍大语言模型发展；自下而上的探索和算力分配必不可少。

shazeer.en: AGI is underhyped; its economic impact will far exceed trillion-dollar products, and coding as an AI application enables self-acceleration of AI progress.
shazeer.zh: 2025 年，他进一步深化观点：AGI（通用人工智能）被低估，其经济影响将远超万亿美元级产品；编码作为 AI 应用能实现 AI 进步的自我加速。
